title: Desenvolvedor(a).NET SR [Open Finance]
description:

  • Implementar integrações e fluxos de Open Finance aderentes a FAPI, mTLS e OAuth2.
  • Configurar e gerenciar certificados digitais para comunicação segura.
  • Automatizar build, testes e deploy com Docker, Kubernetes e CI/CD (Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions).
  • Aplicar TDD, xUnit/NUnit e testes de integração e carga, garantindo performance e estabilidade.

  • Backend: C#, .NET 6+, Entity Framework Core, LINQ, API Full Rest

  • Atuação remota

title: Especialista em Inteligência Comercial
description:
A Voltz é a fintech do Grupo Energisa.


Somos um hub de produtos financeiros escaláveis e geradores de valor nos ecossistemas de serviços básicos.


Começamos com a oferta de serviços digitais para pessoas físicas e expandimos nossa atuação para meios de pagamento e soluções para gestão financeira.


Além disso, oferecemos possibilidades de negociação para consumidores de serviços essenciais e crédito para fornecedores.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

O dia a dia:


  • Mapear e automatizar processos nas áreas de Vendas, Sucesso do Cliente e Operações , implementando soluções em ferramentas como Pipefy, RD Station ou similares para garantir eficiência e padronização.
  • Apoiar e otimizar os fluxos de geração, qualificação e repasse de leads , assegurando agilidade e qualidade na entrega ao time comercial.
  • Gerir e formalizar propostas, inserções e contratos , garantindo rastreabilidade, agilidade e conformidade.
  • Construir e monitorar indicadores de performance (KPIs) , históricos de dados e painéis de acompanhamento , utilizando ferramentas de BI como Power BI ou Looker .
  • Identificar gargalos operacionais e oportunidades de melhoria contínua ao longo de toda a jornada do cliente.
  • Criar e aplicar controles e checkpoints em processos comerciais, incluindo exceções e interações manuais, assegurando qualidade e eficiência.
  • Manter alinhamento estratégico com áreas como Produto, Dados, UX, Marketing, Crédito e Tecnologia, garantindo coerência nas iniciativas e processos.
  • Participar do desenho e aprimoramento do pitch de vendas , definição de públicos-alvo e estratégias de segmentação para campanhas de aquisição e ativação de clientes.
  • Atuar no apoio à pré-venda , organizando fluxos e ferramentas de CRM para elevar a qualidade dos leads e otimizar processos de qualificação.
  • Apoiar a gestão de processos de pós-venda e suporte , promovendo melhorias contínuas e redução de gargalos operacionais.


Requisitos e qualificações:

Para essa posição, esperamos que você tenha:


  • Experiência em Planejamento Comercial , Operações de Vendas ou Produtos Financeiros .
  • Perfil fortemente Data Driven , com domínio de métricas, KPIs e análise de performance.
  • Conhecimento avançado em Visão Sistêmica : compreender como cada parte do negócio se conecta e impacta o todo.
  • Foco em Resultados : orientação clara para o cumprimento de metas e objetivos estratégicos da empresa.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de automação (ex.: N8N ou similares) e CRM (ex.: RD Station, Pipefy, Salesforce).
  • Habilidade em mapeamento e melhoria de processos (BPM, SIPOC, 5W2H etc).
  • Conhecimentos em ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Looker ou similares).
  • Desejável familiaridade com produtos financeiros como crédito, antecipação de recebíveis, faturas e seguros.


Informações adicionais:

OS BENEFÍCIOS PARA OS VOLTZERS


  • Plano de saúde e odontológico;
  • Vale Refeição e/ou Vale Alimentação.
  • Gympass;
  • Horário flexível;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • PLR atrelado a metas e resultados.

title: SAP Basis Consultant
description:
Analista PL / Consultor SAP Basis



Responsabilidades:


1. Fornecer suporte técnico avançado, aderindo aos padrões de qualidade e requisitos regulamentares, garantindo a conformidade com as políticas da empresa nos ambientes SAP Basis e SAP HANA DB.

2. Resolver incidentes complexos escalados por analistas, realizando análises de causa raiz completas e implementando soluções eficazes para resolver problemas técnicos e de segurança.

3. Facilitar a transferência de conhecimento, atualizando e gerenciando a base de conhecimento, treinando novos membros da equipe e orientando analistas para aprimorar as capacidades da equipe.

4. Gerenciar e resolver chamados complexos dentro dos SLAs acordados, colaborando com equipes de suporte multifuncionais para manter a eficiência operacional e garantir uma postura de segurança robusta.

5. Aprimorar a experiência do cliente, alcançando altas taxas de resolução no primeiro contato, minimizando resoluções rejeitadas e reaberturas de casos, enquanto mitiga proativamente as ameaças à segurança.


Requisitos:

  • Inglês avançado. - boa comunicação, participação em chamadas, etc. (OBRIGATÓRIO)
  • Sólido conhecimento do pacote de soluções SAP e arquitetura técnica, com capacidade de traduzir desafios de negócios.
  • 4. Fortes habilidades de consultoria e gestão de stakeholders – habilidades demonstráveis de apresentação, consultoria voltada para o cliente e influência até o nível executivo (C-suite). Todos os candidatos devem ser assertivos e articulados, com capacidade de desenvolver e manter relacionamentos com clientes de alto nível.
  • 5. Compreensão da estratégia de produto da SAP, incluindo o posicionamento do S/4HANA e ferramentas de habilitação e tecnologias complementares, especialmente a integração com outros aplicativos.
  • 6. Bom conhecimento das ofertas de nuvem pública GCP, AWS e Azure e arquitetura de soluções.

title: Gerente de Operações (GIS)
description:
Buscamos um(a) Gerente de Operações para atuar na liderança e gestão de projetos, sendo responsável pelo planejamento, controle e execução de projetos industriais, navais e de óleo e gás, assegurando o cumprimento de prazos, custos, qualidade, segurança e requisitos contratuais.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Desenvolver, atualizar e garantir a execução do Plano de Execução do Projeto (PEP), abrangendo escopo, cronograma, orçamento, qualidade, QSMS e interfaces;
  • Planejar e controlar cronogramas detalhados (nível 3 ou 4), assegurando cumprimento do caminho crítico, alocação eficiente de recursos e mitigação de riscos;
  • Gerenciar custos, produtividade, riscos, mudanças e previsões financeiras, promovendo cultura de controle e melhoria contínua;
  • Liderar equipes multidisciplinares (soldagem, elétrica, refrigeração, mecânica, inspeção, NDT, estruturas, entre outras), promovendo engajamento, desenvolvimento e alta performance;
  • Gerenciar mobilizações, logística, materiais, equipamentos e certificações, garantindo prontidão operacional e compliance;
  • Assegurar a execução das atividades conforme procedimentos, desenhos, CTRs, normas técnicas e melhores práticas do setor;
  • Gerir equipes próprias e subcontratadas em atividades de construção, reparos, IMR e comissionamento;
  • Validar MTOs, garantindo aderência ao escopo, quantidades, especificações técnicas e rastreabilidade de materiais;
  • Monitorar progresso físico, produtividade e KPIs das frentes de trabalho, propondo ações corretivas quando necessário;
  • Garantir conformidade com as Normas NR-10, NR-13, NR-33, NR-35, requisitos IACS, ABS, DNV e exigências dos clientes;
  • Implementar planos de qualidade e inspeção, gerenciar NCRs, testes, inspeções e punch lists
  • Liderar análises de risco e HAZIDs, garantindo a aplicação de medidas de controle em campo
  • Atuar como ponto focal operacional junto ao cliente, assegurando alinhamento e comunicação eficaz;
  • Conduzir reuniões, auditorias e inspeções técnicas e operacionais;
  • Emitir relatórios semanais e mensais com indicadores de prazo, custo, QSMS, progresso e produtividade;
  • Registrar evolução de escopo, desvios e justificativas;
  • Conduzir sessões de lições aprendidas e implementar melhorias contínuas;
  • Manter alinhamento constante com a área Comercial quanto a impactos operacionais e execução conforme escopo contratado.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia Mecânica, Naval, Elétrica, Produção, Petróleo ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência mínima de 10 anos na área ou em função similar;
  • Experiência comprovada em projetos EPC e IMR;
  • Vivência em projetos industriais, navais ou de óleo e gás;
  • Sólida experiência em planejamento, controle de custos, análise de produtividade e gestão de grandes equipes;
  • Inglês fluente;
  • Conhecimento em metodologia EPC e gestão de projetos industriais;
  • Experiência com MS Project ou Primavera;
  • Conhecimento em ERP (TOTVS/Fluig), plataformas de gestão de projetos e dashboards de BI;
  • Conhecimento das Normas NR-10, NR-13, NR-33, NR-35;
  • Conhecimento dos requisitos IACS, ABS e DNV.


Requisitos desejáveis

  • Experiência em projetos para a Petrobras;
  • Conhecimentos avançados em Microsoft Office (Word, Excel e PowerPoint);
  • Conhecimentos avançados em gestão e melhoria de processos.

title: Support Specialist
description:
At Drip, we believe the world needs independent retail. Thousands of ecommerce brands all over the globe trust Drip to build engaging and profitable relationships with their customers. Our Nurture Marketing Platform has generated more than $1 billion in revenue for our customers since 2018. We do this by unleashing the power of direct-to-consumer brands’ customer data to deliver perfectly personalized email and SMS marketing strategies that are proven to grow their revenue. And we’re just getting started! We are well-funded, growing super fast, and building a beautiful product with crew members located around the US and in our Minneapolis Hub. 


Working at Drip means empowering the ecommerce rebellion alongside some of the best people in the biz. We've worked hard to build an awesome company culture based on our 5 Guiding Principles that are more than just words on a wall (learn more: Ready to empower the rebellion? Join Drip!



About the opportunity

As a Support Specialist at Drip, you’ll be part of our small, nimble team providing technical guidance and unparalleled support for our customers. Our world-first product is in the hands of global merchants, and our team is a critical piece in ensuring their success during usage. The specialist acts as the first point of contact for clients or users facing technical challenges and is expected to provide clear communication and effective solutions. The working hours for this position are 9:00am - 5:30pm US Central Time M-F.

﻿This is a full-time contractor engagement (PJ). You will be a fully integrated member of our global crew. 




We’re engaging and collaborative as we resolve questions and help create customer-facing self-help resources. How do we do that?



Key Responsibilities:
  • Troubleshooting & Problem Solving
  • Diagnose and resolve software and network-related issues.
  • Assist users in resolving technical problems with applications, computer systems, and network devices.
  • Identify root causes of issues and recommend solutions or escalate to higher-level support as needed.
  • Customer Support
  • Provide timely and effective customer service via email, chat, or video.
  • Guide customers through problem-solving steps, explaining technical details in an understandable manner.
  • Document customer issues and solutions in a ticketing system.
  • Documentation & Reporting
  • Create and update technical documentation, user guides, and FAQs.
  • Report recurring technical issues to management or product development teams to address underlying problems.
  • Maintain detailed records of customer interactions, resolutions, and troubleshooting processes.
  • Escalation Management
  • Work with the Escalations Team to escalate complex issues when first-line troubleshooting does not resolve the problem.
  • Collaborate with other departments (Product, Engineering, Success) to ensure comprehensive issue resolution.

    • Skills & Qualifications:
    • Technical Expertise:
    • Proficiency in operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux) and common software applications.
    • Strong understanding of network configurations, protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP), and hardware components.
    • Familiarity with ticketing systems and remote troubleshooting tools.
    • Technically inclined with the ability to understand and work with APIs, integrations, and data flows between systems.
    • Comfortable reading and interpreting light code (e.g., JSON, HTML, basic scripting) to diagnose issues, troubleshoot integrations, and collaborate effectively with engineering teams.
    • Curious and adaptable, with a desire to learn new tools, technologies, and platforms quickly.
    • Problem-solving Ability:
    • An analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues quickly.
    • Capable of working under pressure and handling multiple tasks simultaneously.
    • Communication Skills:
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to explain technical issues to non-technical users.
    • Strong customer service skills with a focus on user satisfaction.
    • Organizational Skills:
    • Detail-oriented, with strong documentation and record-keeping abilities.
    • Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.



    Preferred Experience:
    • Previous experience in a help desk, IT support, or technical support role.
    • Knowledge of cloud-based services (e.g., AWS, Azure) and virtualization technologies.
    • Experience with troubleshooting mobile devices (Android, iOS).
    • Familiarity with APIs, integrations, or automation concepts (hands-on experience a plus, but not required).
    • Comfort reviewing technical documentation or light code to support troubleshooting and collaboration with engineering teams.
    • Previous work with an American company
    Education & Certifications:
    • Formal education in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline is preferred but not required.
    • Equivalent experience gained through professional work, certifications, technical training programs, or self-study is highly valued.
    • Continuous learning mindset, with interest in understanding APIs, integrations, and modern SaaS platforms.


    Who You Are:

    • A solid technical aptitude - we love tech support backgrounds or a history of self-started technical growth.
    • You’re an empathetic self-starter who loves technology and enjoys helping others to successfully use it - this isn’t run-of-the-mill customer service, we strive for the Melt Your Face experience! We represent the human side of Drip
    • Passion for helping others internally and externally 
    • Impeccable written and verbal communication and strong attention to detail
    • In addition, we give bonus points for having a SaaS or Ecommerce background!

title: Senior Carrier Business Development Executive
description:
China Mobile International Limited (CMI) is a wholly-owned subsidiary of China Mobile. In order to provide better services to meet the growing demand in the international telecommunications market, China Mobile established CMI in December 2010, headquartered in Hong Kong, China. CMI has expanded its footprint in 39 countries and regions.

Leveraging the strong support by China Mobile, CMI is a trusted partner that provides comprehensive international information services and solutions to international enterprises, carriers and mobile users.


We are looking for a dynamic and proactive Senior Carrier Business Development Executive to join our team.


This role is responsible for driving business growth through new customer acquisition, account management, and strategic carrier partnerships across Voice, A2P messaging, and eSIM mobility products. The position plays a critical role in expanding market penetration, optimizing commercial conditions, and ensuring smooth operational execution in close collaboration with internal, regional, and HQ teams.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Establish, develop, and expand business relationships with customers and partners across Voice, A2P and/or eSIM mobility products, driving new revenue opportunities and account growth.
  • Define and execute sales and business development strategies, managing a structured sales pipeline by customer account and region to achieve revenue and market penetration targets.
  • Manage customer accounts end to end, including commercial negotiations, daily operational follow-up, service performance review, and after-sales support.
  • Develop and manage strategic relationships with global Voice, A2P, and mobile carriers, leading negotiations to secure competitive pricing, routing, capacity, and commercial terms.
  • Lead carrier and customer contract execution, including onboarding, implementation, performance monitoring, and renewals.
  • Monitor market trends, customer needs, and carrier performance to identify growth, optimization, and partnership opportunities.
  • Support the optimization of Voice, A2P and/or eSIM mobility supply networks, ensuring service continuity, cost efficiency, and scalability.
  • Work closely with internal commercial, technical, and operational teams to ensure smooth end-to-end execution from opportunity identification to service activation.
  • Collaborate with HQ and regional teams to align on sales targets, partnership strategies, and overall business performance.
  • Analyze commercial and operational performance and prepare sales and performance reports for management review.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Solid telecommunications experience in the LATAM market.
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken) is mandatory.


Preferred Requirements:

  • Advanced to fluent proficiency in Spanish or Mandarin Chinese.

title: Executivo Comercial Hunter - Grandes Contas - Mercado Pago | Natal, RN.
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!


Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.

Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico, para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques. Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.



Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:

  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.



Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:


  • Prospectar ativamente novos clientes com o perfil de Grandes Contas.
  • Atuar de forma consultiva, compreendendo as dores e oportunidades dos clientes para propor soluções completas de valor agregado ao negócio.
  • Gerir todo o funil de vendas, desde a prospecção até o fechamento e onboarding do cliente sendo usuário modelo dos sistemas da companhia.
  • Sustentar relacionamentos estratégicos com clientes e parceiros de negócio e monitorar tendências de mercado, comportamento da concorrência e oportunidades de crescimento para a sua região de atuação.
  • Trabalhar em sinergia com equipes de produtos e operações para garantir a melhor entrega ao cliente.
  • Ser consultivo para atuar no detalhe durante as negociações sobre os serviços financeiros do Mercado Pago, Meios de Pagamento e Software de Gestão.



Requisitos:


  • Possuir graduação completa.
  • Ter experiência na prospecção de clientes para grandes contas no sesgmento de meios de pagamento.
  • Contar com experiência sólida em vendas consultivas B2B nos segmentos de serviços financeiros, adquirência ou meios de pagamento.
  • Possuir vivência comercial em cenários de metas.
  • Possuir disponibilidade para trabalho presencial.
  • Possuir carro próprio.



Nós lhe propomos:

  • Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.
  • Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.
  • Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.
  • Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)



O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Você tem acesso a todas as oportunidades abertas no nosso site de carreiras. Caso receba pedidos de dinheiro, desconfie!

title: Partner Strategy & Management Manager
description:
At Keeta, we are building the future of food delivery in Brazil. As part of Meituan’s global ecosystem, our mission is clear: help people eat better and live better.


We are looking for a Partner Strategy & Ecosystem Manager to architect and scale our partner ecosystem. This is a strategic role responsible for designing commercial frameworks, performance systems, and lifecycle processes that enable partners to grow while strengthening platform performance.


About the Role


In this role, you will define how Keeta structures, incentivizes, manages, and scales Sales BPO. You will balance commercial objectives with partner enablement, ensuring sustainable growth across the marketplace.

You will act as the strategic bridge between partners and internal stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities


Partner Strategy & Process Framework

• Design comprehensive partner strategies, including commercial models and incentive structures

• Develop partnership economics that balance growth and profitability

• Optimize compensation and performance frameworks aligned with market dynamics


End to End Partner Lifecycle

• Build scalable onboarding, training, and enablement processes

• Define recruitment, evaluation, and transition standards

• Create structured frameworks for ongoing partner support


Performance Management & Execution

• Develop and implement partner performance evaluation systems

• Analyze performance results and drive improvement initiatives

• Translate strategic priorities into clear execution plans for partner managers


Settlement & Operational Excellence

• Execute partner settlement processes with accuracy and timeliness

• Identify opportunities to improve settlement efficiency and transparency

• Partner with Product to enhance systems and workflow automation


Requirements

• Experience in food delivery, e-commerce, marketplace, or on demand services

• Experience building scalable partner lifecycle processes

• Strong analytical skills with Excel, SQL, or BI tools

• Advanced English proficiency for cross border collaboration

• Availability to work on site in São Paulo


Why Join Keeta

• Shape the strategic foundation of Keeta’s partner ecosystem in Brazil

• High ownership and visibility from day one

• International exposure with global collaboration

• Startup speed combined with global scale support


If you are excited about building scalable partner ecosystems, designing commercial strategies, and driving marketplace growth, we would love to hear from you.

#Keeta #EatBetterLiveBetter #PartnerStrategy #Marketplace #CommercialStrategy #EcosystemGrowth

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Company Description


EMP is a media and technology company building audience-driven brands across digital media, content, and now SaaS products.

We started as a digital media group with a fan-first mindset and have grown into a company that blends content, distribution, and technology. Today, we are expanding beyond media into software products that support creators, brands, and audiences. That means design work here goes beyond social graphics and videos. It increasingly touches product thinking, UX/UI, and how software is presented to users.

We move fast, test often, and care about clean execution. Collaboration matters, but so does ownership. If you like building things that ship and actually get used, you will fit in well here.


You Are


An experienced graphic designer who can execute high-quality visual work across media and digital products. You are comfortable working in fast-moving environments, collaborating with editors, marketers, and product-minded teammates. You care about clarity, usability, and aesthetics, not just making things look cool.

You are also curious about software and product design, and you are interested in expanding your skill set into UX/UI and SaaS-oriented design work.


Role Description

This is a full-time, remote role for a Graphic Designer.

You will create visual assets across our media brands, including graphics, branding elements, and design systems for social, web, and video. You will also support our growing SaaS initiatives by contributing to UX/UI design, product mockups, and software framing using tools like Figma.

Your work will sit at the intersection of content, marketing, and product. You will help translate ideas into clean visuals, clear user flows, and consistent brand experiences across platforms.

Day-to-day responsibilities include concepting, designing, iterating based on feedback, and collaborating with media, marketing, and product stakeholders.


Responsibilities


  • Design graphics, branding assets, and visual systems for digital media platforms
  • Support video and social content with strong visual design
  • Contribute to UX/UI design for SaaS and internal software products
  • Create wireframes, mockups, and product flows using Figma
  • Maintain brand consistency across media, web, and product surfaces
  • Collaborate with marketing, content, and product teams
  • Iterate quickly and incorporate feedback without friction


Qualifications


  • Strong foundation in graphic design and visual communication
  • Experience with branding, logo design, and typography
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite
  • Working knowledge of Figma and interest in UX/UI or product design
  • Attention to detail and strong design judgment
  • Clear communication skills and ability to work independently in a remote setup
  • Experience in digital media, marketing, or tech is a plus
  • Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or equivalent experience
  • Fluent in English, written and spoken

title: Research Engineer, Coding Agents
description:
About Turing

Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.


The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Coding Agents to help deliver frontier-quality datasets, RL environments, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art coding models and software engineering agents for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.

This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their coding agent improvement goals into concrete data and environment specs — designing tasks that reflect real software engineering work and building the ground-truth systems that verify agent performance.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience, ideally combining strong software engineering fundamentals with exposure to ML/AI systems — especially where results depended on data quality, evaluation rigor, or building infrastructure that other engineers rely on.


What You'll Do:

1. Design and deliver datasets and RL environments for coding agents

  • Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for coding agent capabilities: codebase navigation, bug localization, patching, test generation, code reviews, CI-like constraints, refactors, and security fixes.
  • Design task suites that reflect real development work — single-step tasks (fix this bug, write this test) through long-horizon workflows (navigate an unfamiliar repo, diagnose a multi-file issue, produce a reviewed PR).
  • Build ground-truth signals: unit tests, structured checks, automatic validators, and reward functions that verify whether an agent's code actually works.
  • Define environment interfaces — repository structures, dependency contexts, tool schemas — that give agents realistic constraints.


2. Build the quality and validation systems that ensure frontier-grade data

  • Perform deep, detail-oriented audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors, reward hacking opportunities (e.g., agents gaming test suites), leakage, and inconsistent assumptions.
  • Implement automated validation and filtering: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, and difficulty/diversity controls.
  • Where appropriate, develop synthetic task generation pipelines: programmatic bug injection, controlled perturbations to existing codebases, and scenario templating across languages and frameworks.


3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals aligned with coding benchmarks and customer-defined capability targets.
  • Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted coding tasks, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift on SWE tasks.
  • When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable coding agent improvement.


4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, QAs, and large-scale data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops grounded in code quality metrics and automated signals.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale task creation efforts, maintaining a high bar for realism and correctness.


Who We're Looking For:

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of professional software engineering or ML engineering experience.
  • Python proficiency required; proficiency in one or more additional major languages (C++, Java, Go, Rust, JS/TS) strongly preferred.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good coding task — realistic difficulty, clear ground truth, and resistance to shortcut solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented: you catch bugs in code that automated tools miss.
  • Experience with testing infrastructure, CI/CD, or code quality systems at a meaningful scale.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning model improvement goals into concrete task specs.


2. Highly valued experience

  • Experience building or evaluating coding agents, copilot systems, or AI-assisted development tools.
  • Familiarity with coding benchmarks (SWE-Bench, HumanEval, or equivalent).
  • RL or post-training work: RLHF, reward modeling, verifier training, or environment design.
  • Experience designing or maintaining evaluation harnesses for ML systems.
  • Comfort with SQL and structured data workflows


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.


Values:

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing:

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours


Don’t meet every single requirement?

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.


For applicants from the European Union, please review Turing's GDPR notice here.

title: Desenvolvedor ServiceNow | Especialista Técnico de Aplicações
description:
Descrição da Vaga (JD):

O desenvolvedor ServiceNow fará parte de uma equipe já estabelecida, apoiando a implementação do módulo Application Portfolio Management (APM) do ServiceNow. O profissional será responsável por ativar e configurar o módulo, além de trabalhar em estreita colaboração com os times funcionais para definir o escopo e os objetivos do sistema.


Como Especialista Técnico de Aplicações, você poderá esperar:

▪ Formular e definir o escopo e os objetivos do sistema.

▪ Ser responsável pelo design do programa, codificação, testes, depuração e documentação.

▪ Ter conhecimento técnico e responsabilidade por todas as fases de análise e programação de sistemas de aplicações.

▪ Compreender o negócio ou a função para a qual a aplicação está sendo projetada.

▪ Aprender continuamente sobre novas tecnologias, gerar novas ideias e melhorar o uso de tecnologias modernas em todo o portfólio de aplicações.

▪ Configurar e ativar o Application Portfolio Management (APM).

▪ Desenvolver relacionamentos de Itens de Configuração (CIs) para Capacidades de Negócio, Objetos de Informação, Aplicações de Negócio e Serviços de Aplicação.

▪ Integrar o APM com outros módulos do ServiceNow, incluindo ITSM e SAM.

▪ Utilizar fortes competências técnicas e expertise para identificar, analisar e solucionar problemas em produção, mantendo procedimentos que atendam às expectativas dos usuários de negócio.

▪ Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes multifuncionais e times de desenvolvimento para entender e fornecer soluções/correções automatizadas.

▪ Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de Delivery e Suporte, bem como para a maturidade dos diferentes portfólios, capacidades, especializações e melhores práticas, considerando as necessidades e requisitos dos usuários e stakeholders.

▪ Participar de eventos SCRUM e concluir os itens atribuídos dentro da meta definida para a Sprint.

▪ Reunir-se com stakeholders-chave e acompanhar os itens de ação para quaisquer soluções alternativas necessárias, de acordo com a natureza dos requisitos.

Qualificações e Requisitos


Qualificações essenciais

• Graduação ou Mestrado em Computação, Eletrônica ou área relacionada

• Certificação ServiceNow System Administrator (CSA)

• Certificação ServiceNow Certified Application Portfolio Management (APM) Implementer

• Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de comunicar informações técnicas para públicos não técnicos


Competências-chave

▪ 8 a 10 anos de experiência total na área de TI

▪ Conhecimento intermediário em linguagens de desenvolvimento: XML, HTML, CSS, Java e JavaScript

▪ Experiência na plataforma ServiceNow como Administrador e Desenvolvedor

▪ Experiência no desenvolvimento de Service Catalogs, implementação de ACLs, transform maps, Flows via Flow Designer, client scripts e métricas de saúde da CMDB

▪ Configuração de Assessments, Demands, Business Capability Maps e Information Objects

▪ Mais de 5 anos de experiência em administração ServiceNow nas seguintes áreas: Service Catalog, CMDB & Discovery, Service Portal, Workflows, Dashboards, REST APIs

▪ Experiência prévia com o módulo APM é desejável


Outras habilidades e competências

▪ Capacidade de adaptação rápida para aprender novas ferramentas, novas tecnologias e padrões atuais do mercado

▪ Capacidade de trabalhar em ambiente global e distribuído, sem supervisão

▪ Perfil autodirigido, proativo e com pensamento sistêmico

title: Realistic Illustrator (Puzzle Art)
description:
About the Role

Mosaic is a fast-growing puzzle company producing highly detailed, realistic illustrations designed for immersive storytelling experiences. We are looking for a technically strong illustrator with a realistic style who thrives in structured production environments and enjoys iterative creative processes.

This role is ideal for illustrators who:

  • Have the ability to separate personal style from production needs and iterate based on clear feedback.
  • Enjoy building complex and maximalist narrative scenes.
  • Are comfortable working from detailed briefs developed by the art department.
  • Deliver consistent, high-quality work within defined production timelines.
  • Adapt seamlessly to a range of techniques and visual approaches within a realistic illustration style.


 Responsibilities
  • Create high-quality, detailed digital illustrations for our puzzles in a realistic style
  • Work collaboratively with our creative team to develop concepts and ideas.
  • Meet production targets and deadlines while ensuring the illustrations meet our standards for quality and consistency.
  • Communication with art and production teams to ensure illustrations are delivered on time and pass our quality checks.


 Must-Have Requirements (Non-Negotiable)
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating realistic, detailed illustration work
  • Experience working with brands, studios, or commercial clients (not only personal projects)
  • High technical skill in composition, perspective, lighting, and color
  • Proven ability to illustrate complex scenes with storytelling elements
  • Availability to work full-time on a fixed schedule (10am–6pm overlap)
  • Comfortable with daily feedback and multiple revision rounds
  • Production mindset and ability to meet deadlines consistently
  • Advanced proficiency in Photoshop, Procreate, Illustrator, or equivalent professional digital illustration tools


 Nice to Have
  • Experience creating artwork for puzzles, games, publishing, or complex visual products
  • Comfort using AI tools for ideation and reference gathering
  • Experience working inside structured creative pipelines


Application Instructions (MANDATORY)

Applications without ALL of the following will not be reviewed:

  • Portfolio with at least 2/3 examples of realistic, highly detailed multi-element scenes (not studies or single characters).
  • Resume or CV

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. title: Account Executive
description:
About UserGuiding


UserGuiding is a leader in the digital adoption field and has earned a 'Best Software' placement on G2 for two consecutive years. We work with globally recognized companies such as TOTVS, WEG, Caju, Wolters Kluwer, DigitalOcean, and Philip Morris International.


Role Objective


UserGuiding is looking for a results-driven, trilingual Account Executive to spearhead our growth across the Americas. Your primary mission is to lead our expansion in the Brazilian market, while also capturing opportunities in North America and Spanish-speaking LATAM.


You will own the entire revenue pipeline for your region, serving as the primary point of contact for prospects from their first discovery call to their final signature.


Main Responsibilities


1. Full-Cycle Sales & Closing


  • Execute Inbound/Outbound: Manage inbound leads and signups from Brazil, the US, and LATAM. Perform high-impact discovery calls and tailored product demos.
  • Negotiation & Closing: Lead contract negotiations and overcome objections to convert signups into long-term partners.
  • Cross-Regional Support: While focused on Brazil (Portuguese), you will leverage your time to handle inbound calls and outreach for the US (English) and other LATAM countries (Spanish).


2. Pipeline Generation & Outreach


  • Proactive Prospecting: Engage with high-intent signups and conduct outbound outreach to key decision-makers (Product People and UX Designers).
  • Event Advocacy: Attend and represent UserGuiding at major industry events and meetups in Brazil to build a self-sustaining pipeline.
  • Thought Leadership: Regularly share insights, product updates, and industry trends to build a personal brand that attracts inbound interest on .


3. Strategy & CRM Excellence


  • Market Insights: Feed local market trends and customer needs back to our Product and Marketing teams to help refine our messaging in the region.
  • Hubspot Management: Maintain 100% CRM accuracy, ensuring all deals are properly forecasted and followed up on.


Candidate Profile & Experience


  • Experience: 2–4 years of experience in a sales-centric role, with at least 1 year specifically as an Account Executive within a B2B SaaS startup.


Linguistic Versatility:


  • Portuguese: Native-level (Primary market focus).
  • English: Professional fluency (Internal coordination & North American deals).
  • Spanish: High proficiency (Managing Spanish-speaking LATAM territories).


  • Skills: Strong consultative selling skills, public speaking confidence, and the ability to navigate a \"no-code\" technical environment. We don’t want someone to show our playground in the first minute. Our sales calls should be in the interview format.


Tech Stack


  • Sales: Hubspot CRM, Sales Navigator, Clay, Apollo.io
  • Comm: Google Meet, Slack.


Compensation & Benefits


  • Base Salary: Competitive fixed monthly salary.
  • Variable Bonus: Uncapped quarterly bonuses based on New Business Revenue (NBR) and pipeline targets.
  • Impact: A high-autonomy role where you directly influence UserGuiding's global expansion strategy.

Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.

  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.  
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.


O que nós estamos procurando;    

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.      
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.     
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.  
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).


O que oferecemos;

  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)       
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados       
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender

title: Brand & Copy Strategist
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yep—you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we’re on the hunt for a Brand & Copy Strategist!


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.


Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.


Purpose of This Position


As a Brand & Copy Strategist, you are responsible for writing and owning all copy for the clients within your squad, ensuring that every word reflects the brand’s voice, positioning, and intent.

You ensure that every piece of written content across websites, social media, email, and campaigns is on-brand, intentional, and delivered at a high standard. You bring together copywriting, brand awareness, practical content direction, strategy, and project management to ensure brands are represented clearly and consistently through words.


You act as the bridge between brand intent and execution, translating client goals and direction into clear, purposeful copy that is ready for internal review and client delivery.


Core Responsibility


Serve as the owner of brand representation through copy for your squad’s clients. Your accountability is defined by the following questions:

  • “Is this copy clear, on-brand, purposeful, and strong enough to confidently move forward?”
  • \"Is this project timeline possible with the resources we have for proper execution?”


Main Objectives


1. Content Execution & Copywriting

  • Write high-quality, purpose-driven copy for:
  • -Websites
  • -Social media captions and post copy
  • -Email campaigns
  • -Campaign and promotional assets
  • Design-related copy (headlines, CTAs, supporting text)
  • Act as the primary writer for all copy deliverables within your squad.
  • Ensure every piece of copy is written with intention, clarity, and audience awareness.
  • Perform copyediting on your own work to maintain consistency, grammatical excellence, and brand alignment, using tools and peers as needed.


2. Strategy & Project Management

  • Create social media strategies for your clients based on their goals and audiences
  • Keep track of client feedback and apply them to future work
  • Plan content in batches for the month, ensuring:
  • -Consistency in writing style
  • -Variety in content types
  • -A range of related, engaging topics


3. Social Media Copy & Content Direction

  • Develop and write social media copy that reflects the brand’s voice and messaging.
  • When appropriate, define content themes and messaging direction for social platforms.
  • When deeper strategy or clarity is required, collaborate with Special Teams to receive social content strategy support or plans.
  • Execute all social media copy in alignment with the strategy you create and flag any gaps or unclear direction early.


4. Creative Collaboration & Brand Consistency

  • Participate in brainstorming and ideation sessions to help define the content, messaging, and assets required for campaigns and initiatives.
  • Provide copy-led input on creative direction to ensure consistency of brand voice, messaging, and intent across all touchpoints.
  • Collaborate with designers, Marketing Coordinators, and Account Managers to align written and visual assets under a cohesive brand narrative.
  • Contribute perspective beyond copy when needed to maintain brand clarity and consistency.


5. Brand Advocacy

  • Act as the copy owner for each assigned brand, ensuring consistent voice, tone, and messaging across all written content.
  • Apply brand guidelines and positioning directly within copy execution.
  • Review copy deliverables to ensure they meet internal quality standards and accurately represent the brand’s intent.


Reporting Relationship

  • This role reports to the designated Account Manager of your squad.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


1. Brand Alignment & Copy Effectiveness

  • Ensure all copy deliverables are consistently aligned with the brand’s voice, tone, and messaging.
  • Maintain minimal client revisions related to brand alignment, tone, or clarity.
  • Contribute social content ideas and messaging angles when needed, ensuring alignment with the brand’s voice, positioning, and goals.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure brand consistency across copy and supporting assets.


2. Content Quality & Accuracy

  • Deliver copy that meets internal quality standards for clarity, structure, and purpose.
  • Maintain a low rate of client dissatisfaction related to copy quality or intent.


3. Project Delivery Timeliness

  • Deliver copy-related tasks within agreed timelines.
  • Collaborate with the squad to support smooth handoffs and on-time delivery of content assets.


Work Details

  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Digital Ad Designer
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle—from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

As a Digital Ad Designer at Lilo Social, you will create scroll-stopping static graphics for Meta advertising campaigns while designing high-converting landing pages that drive measurable results for DTC brands. You will collaborate closely with creative strategists and media buyers to translate performance insights into compelling visual creative that captures attention and converts browsers into buyers.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent improvement in creative performance metrics (CTR, conversion rate, thumb-stop rate) across your client portfolio
  • Fast iteration speed that enables creative variations per week with maintained quality standards
  • High client satisfaction through on-brand designs that align with strategic creative direction
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration that accelerates testing velocity and produces scalable winning concepts


Responsibilities

  • Design high-performing static graphics for Meta ad campaigns across feed, stories, and reels formats
  • Create conversion-focused landing pages that align with ad messaging and drive customer action
  • Execute on creative briefs provided by strategists, translating concepts into visually compelling designs
  • Iterate quickly based on performance data, A/B test results, and stakeholder feedback
  • Maintain brand consistency and visual standards across multiple client accounts simultaneously
  • Design mobile-first experiences optimized for Meta's platform specifications and best practices
  • Organize and manage design files, asset libraries, and version control using established naming conventions
  • Collaborate with media buyers to understand campaign objectives and creative testing priorities
  • Stay current on Meta platform trends, ad formats, and direct response design principles
  • Produce landing page designs that integrate seamlessly with existing brand systems and conversion frameworks
  • Participate in creative reviews and provide design rationale grounded in performance marketing principles
  • Adapt existing creative concepts into new formats, sizes, and placements efficiently


Requirements

  • 3-4 years of design experience in performance marketing, advertising, or DTC ecommerce
  • Expert proficiency in Figma for design collaboration and file organization
  • Strong command of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop and Illustrator)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response creative and performance-focused design work
  • Proven experience designing ads specifically for Meta (Facebook and Instagram)
  • Understanding of mobile-first design principles and responsive layout techniques
  • Demonstrated ability to iterate quickly while maintaining high quality standards
  • Experience designing landing pages with conversion rate optimization in mind
  • Organized approach to file management with attention to naming conventions and version control
  • Comfort working with performance feedback and data-driven design decisions
  • Strong communication skills and ability to articulate design decisions
  • Self-starter mentality with ability to manage multiple client accounts and deadlines


Nice to Have

  • Motion graphics or animation skills with proficiency in After Effects or similar tools
  • Experience with landing page builders (Unbounce, Instapage, Replo, Shogun)
  • HTML/CSS knowledge for basic landing page customization
  • Understanding of Meta Ads Manager and campaign performance metrics
  • Experience working in an agency environment with multiple simultaneous client accounts
  • Familiarity with Shopify and ecommerce product page design
  • Knowledge of direct response copywriting principles and how they inform design hierarchy
  • Experience designing for additional platforms (TikTok, Google Display, YouTube)


Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Mainframe Automation Engineer (zOS) - HOME OFFICE
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer (zOS Automation and CA OPS/MVS) to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a potentially long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries. This client is working with one of the major players in the mainframe technology and tools area.


Job location: Remote, work from home anywhere in Brazil .


All interviews will be in English only (must be professionally fluent).


We are seeking an experienced Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer to lead the migration and optimization of mainframe automation solutions. This role focuses on transitioning from CA OPS/MVS to IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS and from CA Automation Point to IBM Systems Automation for Integrated Operations Management (SAIOM) . The successful candidate will play a critical role in ensuring operational efficiency, system availability, and seamless automation processes within a complex z/OS environment.


You will collaborate closely with the Automation team to implement policy-based automation solutions, reduce administrative overhead, and enhance system responsiveness. This position does not impact application development but will significantly influence automation strategies and operations.


Job responsibilities :

  • Lead migration projects from CA OPS/MVS to IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS and CA Automation Point to IBM SAIOM.
  • Configure and implement IBM Systems Automation solutions, including policy-based automation for z/OS environments.
  • Develop and maintain automation rules, REXX execs, and System Automation Policy Database (PDB) configurations.
  • Provide installation and configuration assistance for IBM automation products.
  • Collaborate with operations teams to optimize system startup, shutdown, and recovery processes.
  • Ensure high availability and efficiency of critical systems through proactive automation strategies.
  • Document processes, configurations, and migration steps; deliver clear communication to stakeholders.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve automation-related issues in production environments.


Key skills :

  • Mainframe Operations Expertise: Minimum 5+ years in a mainframe operations environment in an operational, service, consultancy, or support role.
  • IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS: Advanced knowledge and hands-on experience.
  • TSO and ISPF: Proficient in using these tools for system management.
  • JCL: Strong skills in Job Control Language.
  • REXX Programming: Ability to write and maintain REXX scripts.
  • System Automation Policy Database (PDB): Working knowledge required.
  • Migration Experience: Proven track record in z/OS automation migration projects.
  • NetView for z/OS: Experience in implementing and using this product.


Preferred Skills and Proficiencies:

  • Knowledge of other IBM Z software, including system operation, configuration, and automation.
  • Familiarity with z/OS system startup and shutdown processes.
  • Experience with SMP/E for software installation and maintenance.
  • Understanding of competing automation products in the mainframe space.
  • Expertise in fully automated system configurations on IBM Z.

title: Senior Azure Cloud Architect

  • Strong hands-on expertise with Terraform, including modular design and remote state management.

  • Strong experience with Azure DevOps, including YAML pipelines and CI/CD governance.
  • Solid experience designing hub-and-spoke network architectures and hybrid connectivity.

  • Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.

  • Define and manage management group hierarchies, subscription strategies, and environment separation.
  • Establish standardized patterns for identity, networking, security, governance, and logging.
  • Build and maintain Terraform-based Infrastructure as Code and integrate it into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Design and maintain multi-stage Azure DevOps pipelines for infrastructure and platform automation.
  • Architect and support enterprise networking, including hub-and-spoke topologies and hybrid connectivity.
  • Support containerized platforms using Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
  • Implement and enforce Azure security, governance, and compliance controls.
  • Collaborate with application, DevOps, security, and infrastructure teams on platform adoption.
  • Provide technical guidance and architectural direction to engineering teams.
  • Continuously improve platform reliability, scalability, and operational excellence.

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience designing and operating Azure cloud architectures
  • Proven experience implementing Azure Landing Zones and Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF)
  • Strong hands-on experience with Terraform (Infrastructure as Code)

title: Implementation Manager
description:
About the job


Sphere Pay is looking for a full-time Implementation Manager based in Miami or Brazil. As an Implementation Manager at Sphere Pay, you will be the critical bridge between our sales/GTM team and our product organization, ensuring customers can successfully integrate and leverage our API-first payment infrastructure. The work you do directly supports our customers' ability to move money with us; you will regularly have an outsized impact on Sphere Pay's customer success and product evolution.

Key Responsibilities:


Technical Discovery & Solution Design: Partner with the Head of BD on discovery calls to gather customer technical requirements. Assess requirements against our current capabilities, architect tailored solutions, and clearly communicate any gaps to our product team. You will translate complex customer needs into actionable product feedback.


Integration Lifecycle Management: Own the full integration lifecycle from initial discovery call through final go-live. This includes creating development guides, providing hands-on support during implementation, and ensuring customers have a clear path to successful integration with our API.


Customer Technical Support: Handle integration requests from the sales team post-discovery. Guide external developers on how to integrate our API, explaining not just the how but the why behind integration decisions.


Product Feedback Loop: Serve as the voice of the customer to our product team. Translate specific customer requests into product requirements and advocate for features that will improve the customer experience and expand our capabilities.


Customer Relationship Management (CRM): Build long-term partnerships with clients acting as the primary point of contact for technical inquiries and strategic planning. Track, report, and update necessary internal systems related to client implementations.


Qualifications:


  • Fluency in English, Portuguese Required - Spanish business level fluency is nice to have
  • 3+ years of experience in sales engineering, solutions architecture, or API Implementation
  • Strong technical background with hands-on experience working with APIs and guiding developers through integrations.
  • Proven experience writing technical documentation, API docs, and integration guides.
  • Experience within payments and/or fintech required.
  • Crypto/Web3 is a plus but not required.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Self-starter comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Fully Remote - Based in Miami or Brazil (preferred).


Sphere Pay is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds and experiences to apply.

Sphere Pay is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workforce. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

description:

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

O(a) profissional será responsável por liderar iniciativas de desenvolvimento, governança de plataforma e soluções de automação industrial, combinando visão estratégica, excelência técnica e interação com múltiplas áreas do negócio.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Andela exists to connect brilliance and opportunity. Since 2014, we have been dedicated to breaking down global barriers and accelerating the future of work for both technologists and organizations around the world. For technologists, Andela offers competitive long-term career opportunities with leading organizations, access to a global community of professionals, and educational opportunities with leading technology providers.

At Andela, we’re deeply passionate about creating long-lasting and transformative growth opportunities for all - and doing it in an E.P.I.C. way! We’re excited to continue building our remote-first team with incredible people like you. After applying for this role, you will join our Andela Community of brilliant technologists by passing a technical screening and live interview. As a community member, you’ll have access to a multitude of exclusive technologist roles.

Join Andela today to access this opportunity and more in our global marketplace!

Our roles are typically filled at lightning speed, so if you’re considering applying, get your application in quickly!



About the client

  • The client operates a global employment technology platform that connects millions of job seekers with companies through a large-scale search engine for job opportunities.
  • The organization is highly data-driven and focuses on building reliable, high-availability systems to support large volumes of traffic and data processing.
  • Their mission centers on improving access to employment through technology, analytics, and scalable infrastructure.
  • The culture emphasizes large-scale data engineering, experimentation, and operational excellence across distributed systems.


About the role

  • We are looking for a Data Engineer with strong experience in modern data platforms to support a large-scale migration initiative to Snowflake.
  • The role focuses on migrating approximately 1,000 datasets while adapting existing pipelines and workflows to a new architecture.
  • You will work with orchestration tools and cloud-based data lakes to ensure reliability, performance, and data quality.
  • The architecture is already defined internally, so the role is execution-focused and highly hands-on.
  • This position requires strong expertise in SQL, Python, and distributed data processing tools.


Responsibilities

  • Execute the migration of approximately 1,000 datasets to Snowflake.
  • Adapt and refactor existing data pipelines to align with the Snowflake architecture.
  • Develop and test pipelines using Python and Apache Airflow.
  • Support workflow orchestration, scheduling, and monitoring in Apache Airflow.
  • Ensure data quality, reliability, and performance across migrated datasets.
  • Work with data stored in AWS S3 data lakes, including partitioning and lifecycle policies.
  • Implement testing strategies for data pipelines.
  • Collaborate with internal teams following the predefined architecture and technical approach.
  • Work with streaming or event-driven data using Apache Kafka.
  • Support distributed processing workloads using Apache Spark.


Must have skills

  • 7+ years of experience in Data Engineering or related roles.
  • 7+ years of experience with Python (7–9 years).
  • Advanced SQL (complex joins, CTEs, window functions, performance tuning).
  • Snowflake (data modeling and pipeline integration).
  • Apache Airflow (pipeline development and orchestration).
  • Apache Spark (distributed data processing).
  • Apache Kafka.
  • AWS experience, especially S3 (data lakes, partitioning, lifecycle policies).
  • Experience in defining and implementing testing strategies for data pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining production-grade data pipelines.


Nice to have skills

  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake migrations (data warehouse modernization, performance optimization, cost optimization).
  • Experience with Apache Airflow migrations (version upgrades, executor changes, or platform migrations).


Conditions

  • Remote role (100% remote). Primary timezone: UTC-6 with at least 8 hours of overlap required.
  • Contractor role (initially 3-month contract, but renewable: expected overall duration up to 12 months).
  • Full-time dedication (40 hours/week).
  • BYOD required (bring your own device).

title: Pessoa Analista de Controles Internos Sr.
description:
Através de um portfólio completo com foco na descarbonização de infraestruturas de energia, a ENGIE oferece soluções integradas capazes de transformar cidades e empresas para que façam o melhor uso da energia baseadas em dois pilares: redução de custos e de emissões de CO2. Desta forma, as soluções customizadas de Autoprodução de energia Solar, Eficiência Energética, Subestações, HVAC, Geração de vapor, Consultoria e Gerenciamento de Energia atendem toda a cadeia otimizando a relação com a energia em diversos setores como Indústria, Shopping Centers, Varejo Multisites, Aeroportos, Hospitais, entre outros.

Para cidades, desenvolvemos projetos de Iluminação Pública e Mobilidade Elétrica tornando-as mais eficientes e colaborando na construção de uma sociedade mais sustentável e eficiente.

Com esta nova relação com a energia, mais otimizada e inteligente, a ENGIE é a líder mundial em transição energética, assumindo um importante papel neste cenário.

A ENGIE tem a responsabilidade constante na criação de um futuro harmonioso em conjunto com a população, gestores públicos e parceiros, rumo a uma economia neutra em emissões de carbono.

Missão do Cargo

Garantir a integridade operacional e regulatória da empresa por meio do desenvolvimento, monitoramento e aprimoramento contínuo dos controles internos, promovendo a mitigação de riscos e a conformidade com normas internas e externas.

Principais Atividades

1. Identificar e avaliar riscos operacionais, financeiros e de conformidade associados às atividades da empresa de energia renovável.

2. Executar auditorias internas periódicas para avaliar a eficácia dos controles internos e identificar oportunidades de melhoria.

3. Manter-se atualizado sobre regulamentações do setor, garantindo aderência aos controles internos.

4. Fornecer treinamento e orientação aos colaboradores sobre práticas e controles internos, fomentando cultura de conformidade.

5. Desenvolver protocolos para tratamento de incidentes de não conformidade, investigando irregularidades e definindo medidas corretivas.

6. Preparar relatórios regulares sobre desempenho dos controles internos, com análises e recomendações à alta administração.

7. Colaborar com TI para integrar controles internos aos sistemas corporativos, promovendo abordagem sistêmica.

8. Avaliar eficiência e eficácia dos processos de negócio, propondo melhorias para otimização e redução de riscos.

9. Facilitar auditorias externas, garantindo fornecimento de documentação e informações necessárias.

10. Efetuar os testes e análises de acordo com as instruções do Grupo para o programa global de controles internos.

Requisitos

  • Superior completo: Administração, Economia, Contabilidade e áreas afins;
  • Idiomas: Inglês avançado;
  • Pacote office Intermediário.


Desejável

  • Especialização (Pós-Graduação/MBA) Administração, Economia, Contabilidade e áreas afins;
  • Pacote Office – Avançado
  • Conhecimento em processos de controles internos
  • Experiência em Big 4

Local de Trabalho

Rio de Janeiro/RJ - Brasil

A ENGIE valoriza e estimula uma cultura de diversidade e inclusão, com orientação para igualdade entre as pessoas, respeito pela vida privada de todos e é contra qualquer forma de discriminação e assédio.

title: Data Analyst V
description:
Título da posição: Data Analyst V BRL

Tipo de contratação: Temporário via agência

Modelo de trabalho: Home office


Visão Geral da Posição

A equipe de Analytics de BMP (Business Model and Pricing) está em busca de um(a) Analista de Dados experiente para apoiar a gestão de performance do negócio e a tomada de decisões estratégicas por meio de análises avançadas. A equipe atua em parceria próxima com liderança, finanças, operações e stakeholders de negócio para mensurar o desempenho das nossas ofertas aos clientes, gerar insights sobre o comportamento dos clientes e impulsionar ações orientadas por dados em toda a organização.


O(a) Analista de Dados desempenhará um papel crítico na transformação de dados complexos em insights acionáveis, no desenvolvimento de frameworks analíticos e na viabilização do monitoramento de performance por meio de dashboards, relatórios e análises aprofundadas. Esta função exige forte rigor analítico, visão de negócio e capacidade de comunicar insights de forma clara para stakeholders seniores.


O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui histórico comprovado de entrega de análises de alto impacto em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, além de estar confortável equilibrando análises estruturadas e recorrentes com demandas ad hoc que apoiam prioridades de negócio em constante evolução.


O que você fará

  • Aplicar forte mentalidade analítica e de resolução de problemas para identificar questões de negócio, lacunas de performance e oportunidades de melhoria, traduzindo-as em abordagens analíticas claras.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de BMP fornecendo insights sobre performance do negócio, eficiência operacional, direcionadores financeiros e KPIs estratégicos.
  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e modelos analíticos para acompanhar a performance em relação às metas e apoiar a tomada de decisão da liderança.
  • Conduzir análises ad hoc e aprofundadas para explicar tendências, variações, riscos e oportunidades, além de avaliar o impacto de iniciativas de negócio.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com stakeholders para entender objetivos, definir métricas relevantes e garantir que as entregas analíticas estejam alinhadas às necessidades de decisão.
  • Atuar em parceria com as equipes de engenharia de dados, finanças e outros times de analytics para garantir qualidade, consistência e escalabilidade das soluções de reporte.
  • Sintetizar análises complexas em narrativas claras e objetivas, apresentando resultados que traduzam dados em insights acionáveis para a liderança sênior.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua de frameworks analíticos, ferramentas e melhores práticas dentro da equipe de BMP Analytics.


Qualificações Mínimas

  • Mestrado em Analytics, Ciência de Dados, Economia, Estatística, Engenharia, Administração ou área quantitativa relacionada.
  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em análise de dados, analytics de negócio ou gestão de performance.
  • Experiência sólida com SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação analítica (Python ou equivalente).
  • Experiência na construção de dashboards e relatórios utilizando ferramentas de BI (preferencialmente Power BI).
  • Forte pensamento analítico, com capacidade comprovada de estruturar problemas ambíguos.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e apresentação, com capacidade de engajar públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Capacidade comprovada de colaboração eficaz em equipes multifuncionais.
  • Inglês fluente.


Qualificações Desejáveis

  • Experiência com análises financeiras ou de gestão de performance de negócios.
  • Familiaridade com técnicas analíticas avançadas (previsão, análise estatística, modelagem de cenários).
  • Experiência com ambientes de dados em nuvem (ex.: AWS).
  • Experiência com pipelines de dados, automação ou ferramentas de orquestração (ex.: Airflow).
  • Experiência com big data ou frameworks de processamento distribuído (ex.: Spark / PySpark).
  • Experiência em organização global matricial.

  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
