title: Principal Technical Support Engineer (Remote)
description:
In our 'always on' world, we believe it's essential to have a genuine connection with the work you do.


We are excited to announce that we are hiring a Principal Technical Support Engineer in working from Brazil remotely to join our team and provide high‑level technical expertise to our Ruckus Premium (BullDog) customers.


Your primary responsibility is to serve as a key technical resource, delivering expert assistance and ensuring prompt resolution of complex customer issues.


How You'll Help Us Connect the World:


You work directly with customers to troubleshoot problems, isolate root causes, and drive cases to closure with a high level of technical accuracy and professionalism. When needed, you reproduce customer scenarios in the Support Lab to validate findings and deepen understanding of the issue.

You collaborate closely with Engineering teams to manage escalations, resolve product bugs, and ensure that long-term corrective actions are identified and implemented. Throughout each case, you provide consistent updates to sales teams, internal management, and customers, maintaining clear communication and transparency at every stage.


Given the nature of the role, you are expected to support a staggered work week when required (such as Sunday through Thursday or Tuesday through Saturday) and participate in a rotating on-call schedule. Flexibility in work hours is essential to accommodate urgent customer needs. You thoroughly document customer interactions, engineering engagements, and action plans to ensure high-quality case management and knowledge continuity.


Beyond case handling, you contribute to the organization by creating and refining knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, and internal training materials. You provide mentoring and coaching to team members to help strengthen overall team capability. You also participate regularly in customer and internal conference calls for high-profile cases and escalations, ensuring issues receive appropriate visibility. All responsibilities are carried out with strict adherence to Service Level Agreement KPIs.


Required Qualifications for Consideration:


  • 8+ years of experience working in the networking space
  • 5+ years of experience working in a TAC
  • Excellent written and oral communication ability, including formal presentation skills to customers, partners, Ruckus accounts and support teams
  • Excellent understanding and applied knowledge of TCP/IP, L3 routing, L2 switching, Multicast, firewalls, QOS
  • Solid understanding and troubleshooting skills with wireless technologies 802.11x, WLAN authentication, encryption, EAP, PSK, Radius, AAA, DNS
  • Expertise of wireless deployments – AP’s, Controllers, Client associations, etc
  • Excellent understanding of RF transmission and antenna behavior
  • Technical expertise in troubleshooting and resolving complex Layer 2/3 and/or wireless issues in multi-vendor environments
  • Experience providing support to direct customers, resellers, and field personnel in resolving company product related issues
  • Ability to provide technical guidance to other members in the team
  • Experience working in a support lab environment for problem replication
  • Experience documenting the sequence of events related to resolving customer technical issues
  • Proficient with analyzing data traces from protocol analyzers such as Wireshark
  • High level of English.
  • Available Monday through Friday or ‘staggered work week’s, i.e. Sunday through Thursday or Tuesday through Saturday and weekend or overnight hours as required.



Why Join Us?

Vistance Networks shapes the future of communications technology, pushing past what is possible. We deliver solutions that bring reliability and performance to a world always in motion. Our global team of innovators and employees are trusted advisors who listen to customers first, then deliver value.


RUCKUS Networks delivers purpose-driven enterprise networks that enable superior business outcomes in demanding environments. Our solutions combine AI-powered automation, proactive network assurance, and context-aware security, providing exceptional performance with simplified management.


If you want to grow your career alongside bright, passionate, and caring people who strive to create what's next…..come connect to your future at Vistance Networks.

title: Senior Data Pipeline Engineer
description:
Senior Data Pipeline Engineer


Location: Brazil (Remote)


About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations.


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is hiring a Senior Data Pipeline Engineer to own and scale the data infrastructure that powers our platform, building integrations, transformations, and orchestration that ensure reliable, analytics-ready data for hundreds of customer workspaces.


Position Overview:


For our Client we're hiring a Senior Data Pipeline Engineer to own and scale the data infrastructure powering our platform. You'll build integrations from marketing and sales platforms, transform raw data into analytics-ready models, and orchestrate pipelines that run reliably across hundreds of customer workspaces. This foundational role requires architectural thinking, experience with ELT patterns, columnar storage, and multi-tenant systems. If you love designing clean data models, building robust pipelines, and connecting new data sources end-to-end, this is the role for you.


What You'll Do

  • Expand our data integrations — add new source connectors (ad platforms, social media, payment processors) with full extraction, loading, transformation, and orchestration flows
  • Write and maintain incremental SQL transformation models across staging, core, and analytics layers optimized for a columnar analytics engine
  • Design and maintain orchestration workflows — event-driven sensors, schedules, partitions, and automated pipeline chains
  • Optimize our analytics warehouse — schema design, partitioning strategies, materialized views, sort keys, and data retention policies for performance at scale
  • Scale our multi-tenant architecture — each customer workspace gets isolated databases, and you'll manage the per-tenant pipeline lifecycle
  • Build data quality checks, freshness monitoring, alerting, and pipeline health dashboards


What You Bring

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in data engineering — we care about your growth trajectory, not just time served
  • Strong SQL skills — CTEs, window functions, complex aggregations, and performance tuning for analytical workloads
  • Production experience with columnar analytics databases (ClickHouse, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or similar OLAP engines)
  • Hands-on experience with ELT pipelines and SQL transformation frameworks (dbt or similar)
  • Experience with modern data orchestration tools (Dagster, Airflow, Prefect, or similar)
  • Comfortable writing data pipeline code in Python
  • Experience with cloud-based data integration platforms for managing source connectors and sync configurations
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience


Nice to Have

  • Experience with marketing and ads platform APIs (TikTok, Meta, Google Ads, Pinterest)
  • Background in multi-tenant data architecture — per-customer database isolation and credential management
  • E-commerce domain knowledge — orders, customers, transactions, RFM segmentation, customer lifetime value
  • Experience with PostgreSQL and cross-database patterns between relational and analytical databases
  • Familiarity with Next.js or TypeScript — our console is built with Next.js, and wiring integrations into the frontend is a plus
  • Understanding of how data models feed into AI/LLM agent systems


Who You Are

  • You have a genuine drive to learn and grow — we hire for potential and curiosity as much as current skill
  • You think in systems — you see how extraction, transformation, orchestration, and the analytics layer fit together as one whole
  • You take ownership end-to-end — from designing the schema to monitoring the pipeline in production
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and can make sound architectural decisions without a playbook for every situation
  • You communicate clearly and enjoy working directly with founders and cross-functional teammates


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect
description:
Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect


Location: Remote (Brazil)



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted technology partner is scaling a modern cloud platform and is seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect to lead infrastructure strategy and DevOps practices. As the platform continues to grow, this role will be instrumental in building scalable cloud infrastructure, strengthening CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring the platform remains secure, reliable, and cost-efficient.


Position Overview


We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer or Architect who will take ownership of infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud operations. You will play a critical role in ensuring the platform is scalable, secure, and reliable while optimizing performance and cloud cost efficiency.

This position requires a hands-on technical leader who can collaborate closely with engineering, security, and product teams while mentoring developers on DevOps culture and tooling.



What You'll Do:


  • Design, build, and maintain infrastructure using Terraform , ensuring reproducible and version-controlled environments.
  • Own and manage Azure cloud infrastructure including networking, compute, storage, identity, and platform services.
  • Architect and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions for applications built with .NET, PHP, Node.js, React, and Next.js.
  • Implement best practices in pipeline automation, testing integration, artifact management, and deployment workflows .
  • Strengthen platform security by implementing IAM best practices, secrets management, network segmentation, and encryption strategies .
  • Integrate security scanning tools (SAST/DAST/SCA) and compliance checks into infrastructure and deployment pipelines.
  • Build and maintain observability using DataDog and SolarWinds , including monitoring, logging, dashboards, and alerts.
  • Define reliability standards including SLOs, SLIs, and incident response runbooks .
  • Optimize cloud infrastructure costs through resource tagging, autoscaling strategies, reserved capacity planning, and cost monitoring dashboards .
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to promote DevOps culture, automation, and self-service capabilities .



What You Bring:


  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure .
  • Deep expertise with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices .
  • Proven experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions .
  • Strong understanding of cloud security practices , including IAM, secrets management, and vulnerability scanning.
  • Experience with Cloudflare services such as CDN, WAF, DNS, and Zero Trust.
  • Strong Linux administration and scripting experience (Bash, Python, or PowerShell ).
  • Experience working with SQL Server in cloud environments .
  • Hands-on experience with monitoring and observability tools such as DataDog or SolarWinds .
  • Strong communication and documentation skills.



Nice to Have

  • Experience with AWS infrastructure such as EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, EKS, or Lambda.
  • Experience with Databricks or modern data platform infrastructure .
  • Familiarity with policy-as-code frameworks such as OPA, Sentinel, or Azure Policy.
  • Experience working with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, or container security practices .
  • Knowledge of FinOps practices and cloud cost optimization strategies .
  • Experience implementing SRE methodologies such as SLOs and error budgets .



What We Offer:

  • Competitive compensation package aligned with senior-level expertise.
  • Fully remote work environment with flexible collaboration across global teams.
  • The opportunity to shape and lead the DevOps architecture of a growing cloud platform.
  • Work with modern cloud technologies and engineering best practices .
  • A collaborative, engineering-focused culture with high ownership and impact .
  • Opportunities for professional development, certifications, and technical growth .

title: Senior Front-end Developer (React.js) - Project
description:
We are looking for a remote, skilled Senior Front-End Engineer with 5+ years of experience in React.js to join our engineering team. In this role, you will be responsible for shaping ideas and user feedback into delightful experiences, developing and implementing user interface components into the latest React.js concepts and workflows, and leading the engineering efforts for user-facing features. You will work with our product and user experience teams to deliver end-to-end features that deliver business value that users love.


This project has a 6-month duration with a possibility for long-term engagement.


Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform allows companies to quickly and cost-effectively adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure the efficacy of those programs against compliance standards, and share program achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with the User Experience and Product teams to create end-to-end designs for new features
  • Take ownership of product features from design, implementation, and delivery, to post-delivery feedback and follow-up work
  • Coordinate development efforts across team members and ensure successful delivery
  • Architect, develop, and implement highly-responsive user interface components using JavaScript and React.js
  • Provide technical leadership to teammates through coaching and mentorship
  • Troubleshoot interfaces and debug applications
  • Monitor and improve end-to-end performance
  • Communicate with and support our customers, and help find and build solutions to their problems


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of experience as a front-end engineer writing single-page applications that communicate with API back-ends, and knowledge of JavaScript, CSS, and HTML
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills and experience with browser-based debugging and performance-testing software
  • A well-developed understanding of frontend concepts and various frameworks
  • A focus on delivering value to customers
  • Great listening skills and a willingness to understand what your customers and team members need to be successful
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentlessness in pursuing goals and solving problems
  • A willingness to learn from others and admit when you've made a mistake


Preferred Experience

  • University degree in computer sciences/engineering or related field
  • Node.js and Python experience
  • Additional Information
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays annually
  • Start: ASAP


Core Client Values

  • The client's values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.
  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders, proving we are dependable
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk
  • Evidence-Based Decisions: Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger


The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people on board from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.


About Velozient

  • We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Content Analyst
description:
Career Opportunity: Content Analyst at Hartwell Companies


Hartwell Companies, a leader in industry innovation and a hub for top-tier talent, is on the lookout for an experienced Content Analyst to join our team. This is an exciting opportunity to make an impact in a dynamic, growth-oriented organization.


About Us: Hartwell Companies bring together strategically aligned businesses with a shared commitment to growth, innovation, and positive impact. We are a collective of dynamic enterprises, providing management experience, fresh insights, and resources to nurture each brand under our umbrella.


Position: Content Analyst

Location: Brazil

Work Model: Contractor Remote

Working Hours: 8 AM to 5 PM EST


Job Description:

The primary purpose of this role is to plan, coordinate, and execute the content strategy for Hartwell companies, including SONCO Safety Marketplace.

The Content Analyst will ensure all website content is SEO-driven and aligned with Information Architecture (IA) best practices to improve search rankings, organic traffic, and user experience.

This role includes creating product descriptions for new product pages, developing content for all website pages, social media, producing customer success cases, and building alliances with organizations, associations, and communities to generate co-marketing initiatives.


Main Responsibilities

  • Plan, create, and distribute valuable content.
  • Lead the development and optimization of website product pages, ensuring excellent user experience and strong SEO performance.
  • Ensure website content supports the SEO strategy, including keyword targeting, internal linking, and Information Architecture improvements to enhance rankings and crawlability.
  • Collaborate with design, video, and content writing teams to produce high-quality, SEO-driven content.
  • Plan and write customer success stories and blog posts for our website. Conduct customer interviews to gather accurate information and brief the copywriting team effectively.
  • Define and pursue alliances with organizations, associations, and communities for co-marketing initiatives.
  • Review and refine digital ad content to ensure consistency and performance alignment.
  • Develop attractive, original content to attract and retain users.
  • Distribute content across channels (website, social media, email, blog).
  • Own and optimize the customer review process.
  • Support the marketing team by conducting client surveys.
  • Measure, analyze, and present results of content strategy efforts, including SEO and organic performance metrics.


Skills and Competencies required:

  • Exceptional writing and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Advanced skill level in Microsoft Office Suite and familiarity with WordPress.
  • Knowledge of web publishing requirements and content structuring best practices.
  • Hands-on experience with SEO and web traffic metrics.
  • Understanding of Information Architecture (IA) principles and how content structure impacts SEO and user experience.
  • Strong familiarity with various social media platforms.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Ability to use own initiative to progress work and to work to deadlines.
  • Flexible and creative attitude toward problem-solving.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with colleagues across business units.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Fluency in English is mandatory, with the ability to write and interact with the US-based team.


Other details of the position:

  • Contract type: Full-time consultant.
  • Working hours: 8 hours daily (from 8 am to 5 pm EST).

title: UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer
description:
UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer


About the Role

We are looking for a UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer to help improve the performance of a large-scale digital commerce platform. This role focuses on identifying friction in critical customer journeys and delivering usability improvements that directly impact conversion.


You will own the Usability workstream, partnering closely with product and analytics teams to analyze user behavior, uncover drop-off points, and design improvements across key transactional flows such as cart, checkout, and payment.


This role is ideal for a designer who combines strong UX thinking with analytical rigor and enjoys working in fast-moving consulting environments where rapid insights and quick wins are highly valued.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead usability analysis across critical customer journeys including product discovery, cart, checkout, and payment.
  • Conduct funnel analysis to identify friction points and conversion drop-offs throughout the purchase process.
  • Partner with product and analytics teams to analyze quantitative data such as conversion rates, abandonment points, and user behavior patterns.
  • Map end-to-end customer journeys to identify quick wins and usability improvements that can drive immediate conversion gains.
  • Design and prototype improvements to transactional flows, focusing on reducing friction and simplifying the purchasing experience.
  • Present insights and design recommendations to stakeholders, clearly tying usability improvements to measurable business impact.
  • Work within a fast-paced consulting team delivering iterative improvements across short delivery cycles.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in UX design or product design
  • Strong experience with data-driven design approaches, including funnel analysis and conversion optimization
  • Ability to collaborate with product and analytics teams to interpret quantitative data and translate insights into UX improvements
  • Experience mapping end-to-end user journeys and identifying usability improvements
  • Proven experience redesigning transactional flows such as cart, checkout, or payment experiences
  • Strong problem-solving and research skills
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
  • Comfort working in fast-paced consulting environments with tight delivery timelines


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with A/B testing frameworks and experimentation programs
  • Background designing for marketplace platforms or high-traffic e-commerce products
  • Experience in consulting or agency environments with frequent stakeholder presentations
  • Familiarity with qualitative usability testing methods, including user interviews and moderated testing


This role offers the opportunity to combine UX design and analytics to drive measurable improvements in customer experience and platform performance. If you enjoy solving complex usability challenges and turning data into impactful design decisions, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Educational Consultant
description:
About the Company

OUP Oxford University Press is a department of the University of Oxford which is an exempt charity whose primary purpose is educational. It furthers the University’s objective of excellence in research, scholarship, and education, by publishing worldwide. Within this, ELT’s objective is to provide high quality materials and services that teach and sell well, enabling us to reinvest in the pursuit of our mission. OUP, the leading global ELT publisher, is seeking highly motivated Educational Consultant (focus in developing new customers) to add to its Brazil team based in Rio de Janeiro city.

This is an exciting opportunity to join our team and the purpose of this job is to carry out promotional and sales activities interacting directly with customers to explore their needs, build trust, and offer a compelling solution based on OUP’s portfolio of solutions and services so that we achieve new customers and expand increase market share. The selected candidates must be a creative and enthusiastic self-starter with exceptional communication, organizational and sales skills, including negotiation.

  • Actively provide information on customer feedback, market trends, and competitor activities via line management to give strong insights for strategy setting
  • Continuously develop and improve portfolio and market knowledge, communication and promotional skills and tools through self-learning and active participation in training programmes

This is a full-time role. Travelling will be required.


Qualifications

The successful candidate will need to possess the following skills:


Required Skills

  • Developed sales skills and techniques

  • Excellent communicator

description:

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Cybersecurity Project Manager
description:
The Project Manager in our cybersecurity/IT services division will lead the planning and execution of complex technology projects, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget . This role acts as a bridge between technical teams (network/security engineers, developers, analysts) and business stakeholders. The Project Manager is responsible for coordinating cross-functional efforts in a dynamic environment, often managing multiple projects or client engagements simultaneously, aligning them with strategic goals and the latest industry practices (e.g., Agile methodology, cloud deployments, security compliance ).

Key Responsibilities:

  • Project Planning & Execution: Define project scope, objectives, and deliverables for cybersecurity and IT infrastructure projects. Develop detailed project plans with timelines, milestones, and resource allocation. Manage the full project lifecycle from initiation to closure, adapting to changing requirements or priorities.
  • Team Leadership & Coordination: Lead cross-functional teams (security engineers, IT staff, developers, client representatives) to ensure collaboration and timely task completion. Assign responsibilities, oversee day-to-day project activities, and maintain team motivation and productivity in both on-site and remote/hybrid work environments .
  • Budget & Risk Management: Manage project budgets and control costs. Identify and mitigate risks and issues proactively; implement contingency plans to address potential project roadblocks or security concerns. Ensure compliance with cybersecurity standards and regulations (e.g., data privacy laws, security policies) throughout project execution.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary contact for internal and external stakeholders. Provide regular project status updates, performance metrics, and risk assessments to clients, senior management, and team members. Facilitate meetings, gather feedback, and manage expectations to maintain alignment with project goals and client needs.
  • Quality Assurance & Delivery: Ensure project deliverables meet the required quality and security standards. Coordinate testing, user acceptance, and security reviews on project outputs (e.g., new system implementations, policy rollouts). Oversee documentation (project plans, reports, compliance evidence) and obtain stakeholder sign-offs.
  • Post-Project Support & Continuous Improvement: Oversee transition of completed projects to operational teams. Conduct post-mortems and lessons-learned sessions to identify improvement opportunities. Stay informed on emerging industry trends (like AI integration in project management , DevSecOps , and new collaboration tools ) to continually enhance project management practices.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

  • Education & Professional Knowledge: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business (or related field). Strong understanding of IT systems, networks, and cybersecurity fundamentals to effectively communicate with technical teams and align projects with security best practices.
  • Project Management Skills: Proven ability to manage complex IT or security projects using project management methodologies (Waterfall and Agile). Proficiency with project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Jira, or Trello) for planning, tracking, and reporting. Skilled in developing project documentation and managing project scope changes.
  • Leadership & Communication: Excellent leadership and organizational skills. Demonstrated experience coordinating cross-functional teams , managing resources, and resolving conflicts. Exceptional communication skills to interface with diverse stakeholders and present project updates in a clear, concise manner.
  • Analytical & Problem-Solving: Strong risk assessment, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. Capacity to anticipate challenges, craft mitigation strategies, and adapt to evolving project needs. Must be detail-oriented but also able to see the big picture to ensure projects deliver strategic value.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced Knowledge: Familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks (e.g., NIST CSF, ISO 27001) and regulatory standards (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA) to integrate compliance into project plans. Understanding of modern IT trends such as cloud computing projects, digital transformation , or AI-driven solutions is a plus.
  • Industry Experience: Prior experience in an IT services or consulting environment , managing projects for external clients or within large enterprise settings. Background in network/security infrastructure projects or software development projects is advantageous.
  • Methodologies: Certifications or hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies (e.g., Certified Scrum Master) or DevOps/DevSecOps practices.

Experience Requirements:

  • Experience: 7+ years of experience in project management within the IT or cybersecurity domain. This should include successfully managing multiple full project lifecycles , with at least several projects related to IT security, networking, or software/IT infrastructure . Leadership experience in a matrixed or cross-functional team environment is essential.

Certifications:

  • Project Management Certifications: Project Management Professional (PMP) or PRINCE2 (highly preferred / required) as evidence of formal project management training and expertise.
  • Security/Technical Certifications: Certifications such as Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) , Certified Information Security Manager (CISM) , or Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) are a plus, signifying an understanding of cybersecurity principles and compliance.
  • Agile/Other Certs: Additional certifications like Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or ITIL Foundation are beneficial and reflect a commitment to industry best practices.

title: Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)
description:
Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)


Location: Brazil


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


Position Overview


As a Backend Team Lead , you will play a key role in leading the backend development team while contributing to the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions that support the company's mission and goals. You will guide and support the backend team while working closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities


  • Team Leadership:

Lead and support the backend engineering team, ensuring effective collaboration, task distribution, and delivery of high-quality software.

  • Platform Development:

Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel , ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.

  • Database Development:

Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes.

  • API Development and Integration:

Develop and maintain APIs for internal and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare systems and third-party services.

  • Security Compliance:

Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare industry standards, including HIPAA , by implementing and maintaining robust security measures and data protection protocols.

  • Mentor backend developers, providing guidance on best practices in backend development, code review, and team collaboration.
  • Support the team in resolving technical challenges and ensure consistent development standards across the team.
  • Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to continually innovate and enhance the platform.
  • Participate in the agile development process, contributing to sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software.
  • Collaborate with the design team to refine the platform's user interface and experience, implementing responsive and intuitive front-end functionalities using modern JavaScript frameworks.


Competencies / Requirements


  • Technical Expertise:

Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL . Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git .

  • Experience:

At least 6+ years of experience in backend development , with a proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web applications. Previous experience leading or mentoring developers is required. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is highly desirable.

  • Problem-Solving Skills:

Ability to tackle complex problems, think analytically, and develop innovative solutions.

  • Communication Skills:

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and efficient platform.

  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

  • Experience with Kubernetes Cluster Administration (design infrastructure that involves one or more Kubernetes clusters, configure, control, and monitor Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with Docker;
  • Experience with Helm.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Experience with Kubernetes App Development (design and development of applications that run in Kubernetes clusters);

title: Senior Tax and Accounting Manager
description:
About the Company

We are a high-growth technology company with annual revenue above BRL 300M , operating under an asset-light model and generating recurring revenue . Our operations span Brazil and the United States , and we are continuously evolving our financial and operational processes to support our growth.


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Tax & Accounting Manager to join our Controllership team and lead the accounting and tax operations for our Brazilian and U.S. entities.

This is a strategic role responsible for ensuring compliance with BR GAAP and US GAAP , managing cross-border tax complexity, and driving process improvements, automation, and operational efficiency across the finance function.

You will lead a team of 4–7 professionals and work closely with leadership, auditors, and international stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close under BR GAAP and US GAAP
  • Manage intercompany consolidation , eliminations, and reconciliations
  • Oversee the Brazilian tax operation , including direct and indirect tax calculations and statutory filings (SPED, ECF, ECD, etc.)
  • Coordinate the U.S. tax operation with external advisors
  • Manage transfer pricing processes between group entities
  • Lead the external audit process and act as the main point of contact with Big Four auditors
  • Identify opportunities for process automation and efficiency improvements within NetSuite
  • Explore the use of AI and automation tools to improve reconciliations, financial close, and variance analysis
  • Lead, develop, and mentor the Accounting & Tax team
  • Provide financial insights and reporting to support leadership decision-making


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting with active CRC certification
  • Previous experience at a Big Four audit firm (Deloitte, EY, KPMG, or PwC)
  • 5+ years of corporate experience after Big Four, ideally in high-growth or technology companies
  • Strong knowledge of BR GAAP/IFRS and US GAAP
  • Experience with intercompany consolidation and transfer pricing
  • NetSuite experience as a primary ERP
  • Fluent English (daily interaction with U.S. teams and auditors)
  • Experience leading and developing accounting or tax teams


Nice to Have

  • Strong background in tax and fiscal disciplines
  • Experience with Brazilian tax incentives (Lei do Bem, Lei de Informática)
  • Familiarity with tax automation tools
  • Experience implementing AI or RPA in accounting processes
  • Experience optimizing NetSuite workflows, scripts, or dashboards
  • Postgraduate degree or certifications such as CPA or MBA in Finance


What We’re Looking For

  • Strong ownership mindset and proactive problem-solving
  • Ability to challenge manual processes and drive improvements
  • Comfort working in fast-paced environments with tight deadlines
  • Strong communication skills and ability to translate complex technical topics to leadership
  • Interest in technology, automation, and innovation within finance

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer | Data Engineering & GenAI (GCP)
description:
Sobre a vaga:


Operamos em duas frentes: a Plataforma Unificada de Pessoas, voltada a People Analytics e diagnóstico organizacional, e projetos de consultoria estratégica baseados em dados para grandes marcas globais. No lado de consultoria, construímos plataformas de analytics, modelos preditivos e camadas de IA generativa que alimentam decisões comerciais de alto nível, incluindo projetos para CPGs com presença em toda a América Latina.


Estamos contratando um(a) profissional sênior para atuar na interseção entre engenharia de dados, modelagem e IA em produção. O escopo é amplo por design: somos pequenos. Não há um engenheiro dedicado só a pipelines e outro só a modelagem. Você faz os dois, e precisa saber quando priorizar cada frente. O trabalho de consultoria é concreto: pegar dados de múltiplas fontes (sell-in, sell-out, P&L, market share, distribuição), estruturar pipelines que não quebrem toda semana, construir modelos que vão para produção de verdade, e desenvolver camadas de Q&A com IA generativa sobre esses dados. A plataforma interna de People Analytics caminha em paralelo, com modelagem de diagnóstico organizacional e integração de LLMs nos fluxos de produto.



Responsabilidades:


  • Estruturar e orquestrar pipelines de dados (BigQuery, GCP) com monitoramento real;
  • Harmonizar múltiplas fontes com nomenclaturas inconsistentes e atualizações diárias;
  • Construir modelos preditivos (XGBoost/LightGBM) e simuladores de cenário;
  • Colocar ML em produção: APIs (FastAPI), versionamento (MLflow, DVC), monitoramento de drift;
  • Desenvolver camadas de Q&A com IA generativa usando RAG, Vertex AI e LangChain;
  • Trabalhar direto com produto, tech lead e fundador — e eventualmente apresentar resultados para executivos de clientes globais.



Requisitos:


  • Superior completo em Ciência da computação, Engenharia de Dados, Engenharia de software ou áreas afins;
  • Python sólido e SQL avançado;
  • GCP na prática: BigQuery, Vertex AI, Cloud Run;
  • Orquestração de pipelines (Airflow, Prefect ou similar) — não só saber o que é, mas ter feito;
  • ML em produção de verdade, não apenas notebooks;
  • Familiaridade com LLMs, RAG e LangChain;
  • Experiência com Metabase ou ferramenta de BI equivalente para entrega de insights a stakeholders;
  • Inglês avançado para leitura técnica, documentação e contexto com clientes;
  • Perfil autônomo: sabe definir própria agenda dentro de objetivos claros.


Perfil valorizado: Quem já trabalhou com dados de negócio fora de grandes empresas de tecnologia — CPG, varejo, RH, mercado financeiro. A lógica de sell-in/sell-out, P&L e market share não é óbvia para todo mundo. Se você já navegou nesses contextos, vai se adaptar muito mais rápido.

title: AI & Innovation Experience Designer
description:
AI & Innovation Experience Designer


About the Role

We are seeking an AI & Innovation Experience Designer to help define the next generation of intelligent commerce experiences. This role will focus on conceptualizing and designing new AI-powered capabilities and hyper-personalized shopping journeys for a large-scale digital marketplace platform.


You will own the AI Tools and Hyper-Personalization workstreams, exploring how generative AI, advanced data models, and intelligent systems can transform how customers discover products, interact with sellers, and navigate digital retail environments.


This role requires a designer who is comfortable operating in ambiguity and enjoys shaping 0-to-1 product concepts. You will translate emerging technologies into compelling user experiences through prototypes, concept designs, and future-state product visions.


What You’ll Do

  • Conceptualize new AI-powered commerce experiences across search, discovery, and personalized shopping journeys.
  • Design innovative features powered by generative AI and machine learning, such as contextual search, personalized product detail pages, AI-generated retail media, and intelligent seller tools.
  • Explore how data and personalization models can create dynamic, hyper-personalized user experiences throughout the shopping lifecycle.
  • Develop concept prototypes and design explorations that communicate future product possibilities and inspire product leadership.
  • Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and data teams to translate AI capabilities into meaningful user experiences.
  • Present forward-looking concepts and design narratives to stakeholders, helping shape the long-term product vision.
  • Operate within a fast-paced consulting environment with short delivery cycles and evolving requirements.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in product design or UX design, with exposure to emerging technologies or innovation-focused work
  • Experience designing AI-powered or data-driven product experiences
  • Strong conceptual thinking and ability to design future-state product concepts
  • Ability to communicate complex ideas through prototypes, visual concepts, and design storytelling
  • Understanding of personalization systems, recommendation engines, or conversational AI patterns
  • Comfort working in ambiguous, early-stage product environments
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
  • Ability to work effectively in fast-paced consulting environments


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing GenAI-powered features, including conversational interfaces, AI search, content generation, or recommendation systems
  • Familiarity with retail media platforms, seller tools, or marketplace ecosystems
  • Experience designing for conversational commerce platforms such as messaging-based shopping experiences
  • Exposure to or interest in the Brazilian or Latin American technology ecosystem


This role is ideal for a designer who enjoys exploring the intersection of AI, commerce, and product innovation. If you’re excited about shaping intelligent, personalized digital experiences and pushing the boundaries of what modern e-commerce can become, we’d love to connect.

title: Editorial Graphic Designer (Interiors + Spaces)
description:
So… who the heck is Residence Supply?


I'm Jacky, the founder. We started as a local lighting brand obsessed with historical architecture and heirloom craftsmanship. In just a few years we blew past 8 figures, launched hundreds of handcrafted SKUs, and built a cult following of design-obsessed homeowners. Our fixtures live in Architectural Digest–worthy homes.


Now we're building the ULTIMATE creative team. One that takes us from \"fastest-growing DTC brand\" to category-defining design house. We need a graphic designer who doesn't just execute... but one who sees the world the way our customers do. Through the lens of beauty, heritage, and taste.


What You'll Do

  • Design editorial ads that feel like they were pulled from a print magazine
  • Translate interior design trends and RS products into visual stories that stop the scroll
  • Build mood boards and visual direction decks to guide campaigns
  • Maintain and elevate brand visual consistency across every creative touchpoint
  • Collaborate with our Creative Strategist, Content team, and Founder on campaign ideation
  • QC all outgoing creative. Nothing ships unless it looks like Residence Supply


Who You Are

  • 3+ years designing for high-end lifestyle, interiors, fashion, or luxury DTC brands
  • Your portfolio looks like a coffee table book, not a social media dump
  • Obsessed with typography, white space, negative space, and editorial composition
  • You follow interior designers, architects, and design publications
  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign)
  • You understand the difference between beautiful and effective
  • Architecture or interior design background? You're already shortlisted.


What We're Building

Residence Supply is not trying to be another ecommerce brand. We're becoming a heritage-driven design house growing 100% year over year. This role will define the visual language that new customers judge us by. Your work will live in catalogs, on Pinterest boards of people building their dream homes, and in the feeds of the most design-literate buyers in the country.


This is your chance to join a founding creative team before the rocket takes off.


What We're Offering

  • Competitive Salary
  • 10 days PTO per year
  • Opportunity to grow into creative strategist/lead graphic designer
  • Fully remote


How to Apply

Don't send us a generic application. Send us:

  • A portfolio or 3–5 pieces you're most proud of... especially anything editorial, catalog, or interiors-adjacent please!
  • A quick paragraph on how you'd approach the visual feel of a Residence Supply print catalog
  • Tell us: what brand's visual identity do you wish you had built and why?


If the interview goes well, we hire on the call. Good luck.

title: Senior SRE Engineer (Temporary Contract)
description:
About You

This is a high‑impact, high‑expectation senior DevOps/SRE role supporting a Private Equity Group (PEG) platform. The team is new, the infrastructure is new, and the customer is extremely selective and private.


You must operate with strong autonomy , influence engineering decisions, challenge assumptions, and serve as a thought partner rather than an order‑taker. You will work directly with VP‑level stakeholders in a technical environment where reliability, deployment safety, and clarity in communication are essential.


This position requires someone who can own DevOps architecture end‑to‑end , enable safe and frequent deployments, and establish operational excellence from day zero.


Note: This position is offered under a contractor model for a period of 6 months .


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies

  • Proven ownership of production-grade CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions reusable workflows and GitOps automation with ArgoCD .
  • Expert-level Kubernetes and EKS operations , including node group management, Karpenter autoscaling, RBAC, PDBs, and topology constraints.
  • Production-scale Terraform expertise , including module design, S3 + DynamoDB remote state , and PR-driven workflows via Atlantis .
  • Strong reliability engineering experience , including SLO/SLI design, alerting strategies, dashboards, incident response, and post-incident reviews.
  • Hands-on experience operating HashiCorp Vault , including auth backends, PKI, dynamic secrets, and audit logging.
  • Experience implementing supply-chain security controls , including image scanning and signing, SBOM generation, and policy enforcement with OPA/Gatekeeper.
  • Strong experience with observability stacks , including Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, and Alertmanager.
  • Experience with service mesh technologies such as Istio , including traffic management, mTLS, AuthorizationPolicies, and circuit breaking.
  • Scripting ability using Python and Bash for automation and operational tooling.
  • Active use of AI-assisted engineering tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Cloud Code to accelerate IaC development, incident response, and runbook generation.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and confidently with VP-level stakeholders during operational incidents.
  • Advanced English proficiency, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain GitHub Actions reusable workflows across a multi-repository ecosystem.
  • Own GitOps deployments through ArgoCD , including promotion workflows, sync policies, drift detection, and automated rollback strategies.
  • Implement deployment safety mechanisms such as environment protections, concurrency rules, and verification gates .
  • Operate and upgrade EKS clusters , including Karpenter provisioning, node groups, and critical cluster add-ons.
  • Maintain Terraform-driven infrastructure and enforce PR-driven workflows through Atlantis.
  • Define and maintain SLOs, SLIs, alerting rules, and monitoring dashboards across platform services.
  • Lead incident response , coordinate recovery efforts, and execute structured post-incident reviews.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation and contribute to improving operational processes.
  • Operate and maintain HashiCorp Vault , including policies, authentication backends, and secret engines.
  • Implement supply-chain security controls , including Trivy scanning, Cosign signing, SBOM generation, and OPA/Gatekeeper enforcement.
  • Partner with Security Engineering on network policies, egress controls, and compliance standards .
  • Automate repetitive tasks and maintain proactive runbooks to reduce operational risk.
  • Use AI tools to improve infrastructure automation, documentation, and deployment safety validation.
  • Collaborate with product teams to strengthen SLOs and deployment safety practices .
  • Challenge technical assumptions and advocate for scalable, secure DevOps architectures .


Qualifications

  • Proven end-to-end ownership of production-grade Kubernetes/EKS environments including Karpenter and Atlantis-driven Terraform workflows.
  • Demonstrated expertise with ArgoCD GitOps patterns.
  • Hands-on experience with HashiCorp Vault, supply-chain security controls, and structured incident response including on-call rotations and post-incident reviews.
  • Active use of AI-assisted tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Cloud Code as part of daily engineering workflow.


Additional Information

About Us


We Are Engineered Different.


At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

title: Especialista em Vendas no Balcão (OTC)
description:
A Mackay Marine é uma empresa global de serviços de eletrônica náutica com mais de 500 funcionários em 60 centros de serviço em 22 países, incluindo Américas, África, Ásia e Europa. A Mackay oferece salários competitivos, além de horas extras, e benefícios como seguro saúde/odontológico, férias remuneradas, vale-refeição e vale-transporte.

A Mackay está buscando um Especialista em Vendas no Balcão (OTC) para o setor náutico, com experiência e proficiência em inglês, para trabalhar presencialmente em nossa unidade no Rio de Janeiro. Candidatos com as habilidades e qualificações descritas abaixo são encorajados a se candidatar.

RESUMO DA VAGA DE ESPECIALISTA EM VENDAS NO BALCÃO (OTC)

O Especialista em Vendas no Balcão (OTC) é um cargo presencial, sem função gerencial, que se reporta ao Diretor Geral do Brasil. As responsabilidades do Especialista em Vendas no Balcão (OTC) incluem, entre outras, a comunicação direta com nossos clientes para responder a perguntas sobre disponibilidade, preço e uso de produtos, bem como fornecer orientação técnica, orçamentos em tempo hábil e propostas abrangentes. Processará transações no balcão, pedidos especiais, pedidos de vendas por telefone e internet, bem como transferências entre empresas. Dará suporte a outros membros da equipe, clientes e contas da empresa com pedidos e entrega de peças para apoiar nossos negócios.

As responsabilidades também incluirão manuseio de materiais e envio/recebimento de mercadorias, o que envolve levantamento físico, manuseio de caixas, paleteiras e pode incluir atividades em escadas, elevadores, empilhadeiras, ferramentas elétricas, ferramentas manuais, transporte e movimentação de peças e equipamentos.

REQUISITOS DO CARGO DE ESPECIALISTA EM ATENDIMENTO NO BALCÃO:

• Atuar como ponto de contato para vendas, serviços e solicitações de informações do cliente para garantir que as necessidades do cliente sejam atendidas com rapidez e profissionalismo.

• Auxiliar na pesquisa de problemas técnicos básicos sobre produtos e serviços. Coletar sintomas de problemas do cliente e facilitar os reparos.

• Auxiliar no atendimento de clientes em potencial ou ligações de clientes quando a equipe de vendas externas estiver fora do escritório.

• Fornecer orçamentos e propostas aos clientes e realizar o acompanhamento em tempo hábil.

• Desenvolver o negócio identificando oportunidades de receita no setor náutico.

• Auxiliar nas funções de expedição e recebimento para facilitar o fluxo e a contabilização de todos os materiais recebidos e entregues para pedidos de clientes, estoque, reparos ou uso interno.

• Direcionar solicitações de serviço ao membro da equipe apropriado.

• Manter a área de trabalho e o estoque limpos e organizados.

• Ler pedidos de clientes, ordens de serviço, ordens de envio ou requisições para determinar os itens a serem movidos, coletados, distribuídos e/ou enviados, utilizando o sistema ERP da Mackay.

HABILIDADES NECESSÁRIAS PARA ESPECIALISTA EM VENDAS DE PRODUTOS DE BANCADA:

• Conhecimento prévio de equipamentos eletrônicos náuticos é um diferencial.

• Capacidade de ler e interpretar documentos como folhetos de produtos, instruções de operação e manutenção, manuais de procedimentos, etc.

• Capacidade de somar, subtrair, multiplicar e dividir em todas as unidades de medida, utilizando números inteiros, frações comuns e decimais. Capacidade de calcular taxas, proporções e porcentagens.

• Atenção aos detalhes e capacidade de organizar materiais de forma eficaz e eficiente.

• Excelentes habilidades de atendimento ao cliente, comunicação (oral e escrita), organização, planejamento e priorização.

QUALIFICAÇÕES PARA ESPECIALISTA EM VENDAS DE MEDICAMENTOS DE BANCADA:

• Dois anos de ensino superior.

• Experiência na área de eletrônica e/ou náutica é desejável.

• Três anos de experiência em vendas internas ou no balcão.

• Bons conhecimentos de informática e internet.

• Carteira de habilitação válida e veículo próprio.

Os candidatos devem estar autorizados a trabalhar no Brasil sem necessidade de patrocínio. A aprovação em uma verificação completa de antecedentes será exigida após a aceitação da oferta de emprego.

title: Analista de Operações - Issuance (Jr)
description:

Acreditamos ser importante que você já tenha passado por algumas experiências e que também tenha os seguintes conhecimentos:

  • Conhecimentos básicos em redes e protocolos de segurança;

  • Disponibilidade de atuar esporádicas vezes (uma vez a cada 30 ou 45 dias) presencialmente na sede da empresa, em Campinas/SP.


Será um grande diferencial se:

  • Conhecimento básico ou contato prévio com Docker, Ansible, Apache e Kong;
  • Conhecimentos básicos de Scrum;
  • Conhecimento ou vivência em monitoração de serviços;
  • Vivência em atividades rotineiras de suporte e projetos, como acompanhamento, execução e atualização de tickets;
  • Noções de comunicação com o cliente e acompanhamento de indicadores (ex.: SLA, FCR, tempo de resposta, entre outros);
  • Espanhol e/ou Inglês em nível básico a intermediário;

O que oferecemos?

A HST é uma empresa certificada GPTW! Oferecemos a oportunidade de crescimento em um ambiente de desafios em que a contrapartida de cada Pessoa equivale ao tamanho da sua vontade de crescer !

Prezamos por um bom ambiente de trabalho que contribua para as pessoas evoluírem e se sentirem acolhidas, livres, autênticas e à vontade para demonstrarem suas habilidades! Apoiamos a diversidade e não temos espaço para qualquer tipo de discriminação!

title: Senior Estimator
description:
Company Overview:

Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we’ve forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing platforms hundreds of miles from shore, using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure, and reshaping the onshore landscape to deliver the energy products the world needs safely and sustainably.


For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries.


Job Overview:

The Senior Estimator uses best practices and knowledge of internal or external issues to improve the estimating discipline within McDermott. They will act as a resource for colleagues with less experience and share their conceptual and practical expertise related to the estimating discipline. The Senior Estimator solves complex problems and uses their discipline-specific knowledge to improve their products or services. The Senior Estimator impacts a range of customer, operational, project, or service activities with the estimating team and other related teams and ensures that they are working within the appropriate guidelines and policies.


Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

Review, query, and understand the scope of work in order to prepare a proper estimate

Gather information and input from functions with support from the project manager

Consult with Subject Matter Expert (SME) to discuss Estimates and resolve issues

Generate estimates with available Benchmark data and from experience prior to receiving the inputs from functions and evaluate the estimates received from functions against the internal estimate

Analyze the cost components that are critical/crucial and seek quotes for applicable items

Participate in Bid review meetings, estimate evaluation meetings, Risk assessment meetings, as well as any additional bid-related meetings, as required.

Prepare a comprehensive Basis of Estimate (BOE)

Review and identify contract price form

Understand and clarify unit rate and lump sum breakdowns


Essential Qualifications and Education:

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering is a plus

5+ years of experience in a large Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) company (preferably in estimating, project controls, and data analytics)

title: Auxiliar de loja

Nacionalmente contamos com +2.000 pontos de venda, além de termos nossa matriz corporativa presente na cidade de São Paulo, e contarmos com 2 centros de distribuição: um em Cotia/SP, e outro em Serra/ES.

Nosso propósito é “impulsionar a moda para o bem”, além de termos como visão “sermos a marca de fashion lifestyle mais admirada do mundo!”. Para isso, temos alguns valores como individualidade, integridade, paixão, parceria e responsabilidade.

Além disso, a CK é conhecida por seu grande compromisso com Diversidade e Inclusão! Todas as nossas vagas são direcionadas a todos os públicos, valorizando a pluralidade de identidades e experiências.   • Relacionamento
  • Estilo
  • Atitude
  • Curiosidade
  • Foco em Resultados
  • Autenticidade
  • Ensino Médio Completo

Seria ótimo se você também tivesse...

  • Experiência anterior na função
  • Conhecimento no sistema Linx

Horário: 44h semanais (6x1)

Vale-refeição ou vale-alimentação (você escolhe)

Vale-transporte

title: Shopify Solution Architect
description:
Job Title: Shopify Solution Architect

Location: Remote

Mode of Hire: Contract


Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced e-commerce Solution Architect to design, scale, and optimize modern digital commerce ecosystems. This role will be responsible for building secure, scalable, and high-performing architecture that supports enterprise-level eCommerce operations.

The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in Shopify and Adobe Magento, along with strong experience integrating complex systems across enterprise environments. You will work closely with engineering, product, marketing, and operations teams to ensure the eCommerce platform integrates seamlessly with core business systems and supports business growth.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable e-commerce architecture supporting enterprise digital commerce operations.
  • Lead platform architecture and integration strategies for Shopify and Adobe Magento environments.
  • Manage and optimize Shopify within a large, regulated enterprise environment, ensuring secure and reliable integrations.
  • Architect integrations between TikTok Shop and Shopify, including catalog management, order processing, and fulfillment workflows.
  • Oversee end-to-end e-commerce data flows including checkout, purchase orders, abandoned cart processes, and customer transactions.
  • Design integrations with enterprise systems such as SAP, APIs, and analytics/data platforms.
  • Ensure reliable data pipelines to analytics platforms such as Snowflake and other data warehouses.
  • Collaborate with product, engineering, and marketing teams to align technical architecture with business objectives.
  • Evaluate and implement digital experience tools that enhance customer engagement and conversion.
  • Ensure best practices around security, performance, scalability, and system reliability across the commerce ecosystem.


Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in eCommerce architecture, platform engineering, or solution architecture roles.
  • Strong experience with Shopify and Adobe Magento platforms in enterprise environments.
  • Proven experience designing and managing complex system integrations using APIs and middleware.
  • Experience integrating TikTok Shop with Shopify, including catalog, order, and fulfillment processes.
  • Deep understanding of end-to-end eCommerce operations, including checkout flows, purchase orders, and abandoned cart workflows.
  • Experience integrating eCommerce platforms with ERP systems such as SAP.
  • Strong understanding of data architecture and analytics integrations, including Snowflake or similar platforms.
  • Experience working within regulated enterprise environments with strong security and compliance requirements.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Customer Data Platforms (CDPs) and digital experience tools.
  • Familiarity with marketing automation and engagement platforms such as: Yotpo, Simon, Attentive
  • Experience with SMS, email marketing platforms, and customer reviews tools within the eCommerce ecosystem.
  • Strong understanding of modern composable commerce architecture.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams across engineering, product, and marketing.


Key Skills

  • eCommerce Architecture
  • Shopify & Magento Platform Expertise
  • API & System Integrations
  • Enterprise Data Architecture
  • ERP Integrations (SAP)
  • Digital Experience Platforms
  • Cloud & Scalable Infrastructure
  • Cross-functional Technical Leadership

description:
Sobre a Empresa:

O Clínica Experts é uma plataforma completa de gestão para clínicas de saúde, estética e bem-estar, utilizada diariamente por mais de 7.500 clínicas e 16.000 usuários. Entregamos soluções que integram agenda, prontuário, financeiro, estoque, comunicação omnichannel e inteligência artificial, garantindo eficiência e escala para operações de todos os portes.


Sobre a Oportunidade:

Buscamos um(a) Engenheiro(a) de IA Sênior para atuar diretamente no squad de IA do Clínica Experts, responsável por projetar, evoluir e escalar soluções baseadas em LLMs, agentes inteligentes e sistemas multi-agentes.

Você trabalhará em desafios reais de produção, com alto volume de dados e usuários, construindo soluções que vão desde engenharia de prompts até arquiteturas complexas de agentes com supervisão, memória, ferramentas e observabilidade.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Arquitetar e desenvolver soluções de IA baseadas em LLMs para ambientes de produção em larga escala;
  • Projetar e implementar sistemas de agentes e multi-agentes, incluindo estruturas de supervisor, delegação de tarefas, memória e ferramentas;
  • Desenvolver fluxos complexos utilizando LangChain e LangGraph, aplicando boas práticas de composição, controle e observabilidade;
  • Integrar diferentes provedores de modelos (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, entre outros), escolhendo o melhor modelo para cada caso de uso;
  • Atuar na definição de estratégias de engenharia de prompt, avaliação de respostas, mitigação de alucinações e controle de qualidade;
  • Construir e evoluir pipelines de IA integrados a sistemas backend (APIs, filas, microsserviços);
  • Participar ativamente da inovação do produto através de POCs, MVPs e experimentos controlados;
  • Definir padrões técnicos, boas práticas e ajudar a elevar o nível do time, atuando como referência técnica em IA.


Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Fundamentos sólidos de IA aplicada e LLMs;
  • Engenharia de prompt (few-shot, chain-of-thought, structured output, function calling);
  • LangChain e seus principais conceitos (chains, tools, memory, retrievers);
  • LangGraph para orquestração de fluxos e agentes complexos;
  • Arquiteturas de agentes autônomos e multi-agentes, incluindo supervisor/worker;
  • Integração com APIs de LLMs (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude);
  • Design de APIs e serviços backend para consumo de IA;
  • Observabilidade aplicada a IA (logs, métricas, tracing, avaliação de respostas);
  • Conceitos de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), embeddings e vetorização;
  • Mensageria, processamento assíncrono e arquiteturas distribuídas;
  • Experiência prática colocando soluções de IA em produção;
  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software, sendo parte disso com sistemas complexos ou distribuídos.


Você vai se divertir mais se:

  • Tiver paixão por inteligência artificial e acompanhar a evolução rápida do ecossistema de LLMs;
  • Gostar de resolver problemas ambíguos e ainda não totalmente definidos;
  • Curte equilibrar experimentação rápida com engenharia robusta para produção;
  • Tiver senso de dono e se preocupar com impacto real no usuário final.


Será um diferencial se você:

  • Tiver experiência com Node.js, Python ou TypeScript em sistemas de IA;
  • Já tiver trabalhado com RAG em produção, FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate ou similares;
  • Conhecer técnicas de avaliação automática de LLMs (LLM-as-a-Judge, scoring, CSAT);
  • Possuir experiência com AWS (EC2, S3, filas, escalabilidade);
  • Ter participado da construção de produtos de IA para usuários finais;
  • Já ter atuado como referência técnica ou líder técnico.


Nossos benefícios:

  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição no cartão Flash;

title: Desenvolvedor.NET/Reactjs Sr
description:
Código da vaga: 57204



Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

  • Frontend: Experiência sólida em React para desenvolvimento de Single Page Applications (SPA). Boas práticas de UI/UX e integração com APIs REST/GraphQL.
  • Backend: Domínio em .NET Core para construção de serviços escaláveis e de alta performance. Experiência com PostgreSQL (modelagem, otimização de queries e administração básica).
  • Cloud & Infraestrutura (AWS) Elastic Container Service (ECS) e Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS) para orquestração de containers. Configuração e gerenciamento de API Gateway para exposição segura de serviços. Uso de Secrets Manager para gestão de credenciais e dados sensíveis. Desenvolvimento e manutenção de AWS Lambda Functions para arquiteturas serverless.
  • Observabilidade & Monitoramento Implementação de alertas e dashboards para garantir alta disponibilidade e performance
  • CLT, salário a combinar + benefícios
  • Híbrido em Botafogo (3x presencial na semana)- RJ.



- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Coordenador de Manutenção

  • Conhecimento em Mecânica, Elétrica, Produção, Noções em Ciências navais e Navegação, Mecânica de propulsores e Lemes, Máquinas navais, Turbinas Sistemas de automação, Sistema de geração de energia, Sistemas hidráulicos, sistema de arrefecimento, Eletrônica, comunicação de rádios VHF e SSB e sistema Vsat;

title: Secretário(a)
description:
A Mackay Marine é uma empresa global de serviços de eletrônica marítima com sede nos EUA e mais de 500 funcionários em 60 centros de serviço em 22 países, incluindo as Américas, Europa, África e Ásia.

A Mackay está buscando um(a) Secretário(a) de Centro de Serviço experiente, fluente em inglês e com as habilidades e qualificações descritas abaixo para trabalhar 100% presencialmente em nossa unidade do Rio de Janeiro. A Mackay oferece salários e benefícios competitivos, como seguro saúde/odontológico, férias anuais, vale-refeição e vale-transporte.

Resumo da Vaga de Secretário(a) de Centro de Serviço

O(A) Secretário(a) do Depósito é responsável por prestar apoio administrativo ao Diretor Geral do depósito no Brasil e encaminhar todas as questões e assuntos de Recursos Humanos à Matriz. As responsabilidades diárias incluem recepcionar visitantes, atender o telefone e responder e-mails, distribuir/enviar correspondências e/ou encomendas, inserir dados, emitir faturas, manter arquivos e criar/atualizar registros/documentos gerados por computador. Outras atribuições podem incluir verificar o estoque, solicitar mercadorias, precificar ordens de serviço, manter registros do almoxarifado e realizar o envio e recebimento de mercadorias.

As responsabilidades incluem, entre outras:

• Seguir sempre as políticas e os procedimentos da Mackay.

• Atuar como recepcionista, recepcionando visitantes e mantendo a área de recepção organizada.

• Atender telefonemas, e-mails, solicitações de clientes e consultas sobre estoque.

• Responder a perguntas dos departamentos de RH Corporativo, Folha de Pagamento, Contabilidade, Marketing, TI, SI e seus executivos. Encaminhar todas as questões ou assuntos relacionados à Folha de Pagamento e/ou Recursos Humanos para o RH Corporativo.

• Coordenar viagens e toda a documentação necessária para os técnicos.

• Manter e atualizar arquivos, registros internos, planilhas, relatórios e correspondências.

• Inserir dados no banco de dados Solomon, processar registros de consultas de vendas e ordens de serviço.

• Coordenar a distribuição de correspondências recebidas e enviadas, e gerenciar as necessidades de envio do depósito.

• Processar faturas semanais e enviá-las aos clientes de acordo com suas instruções.

• Processar relatórios de despesas, manter registros internos de férias/licença médica e relatórios diários de horas trabalhadas para engenheiros de serviço.
